translations.literal: Welcoming the Spirit, "Moderation and Harmony": how august, serene and pure — vast covering is only benevolence; already completing the myriad treasures — favoring this multitude of people.
translations.idiomatic: Welcoming the Spirit — "Moderation and Harmony": how august, serene and pure, spreading benevolence alone; completing the myriad treasures, favoring all the people.

sentences.zh: 祗受厥明兮欲報無因，爰稽古昔兮式展明禋。

translations.literal: Reverently receiving that brilliance — wishing to repay yet without means; thus examining ancient times — formally unfolding the bright sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Reverently receiving that brilliance, we wish to repay yet lack the means; examining antiquity, we perform the bright sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 肅肅廣庭兮遙遙紫旻，笙鏞始奏兮祥風導云。

translations.literal: Solemn, solemn is the broad courtyard — far, far the purple heavens; sheng and bells first perform — auspicious wind guides the clouds.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn is the broad courtyard, far stretch the purple heavens; sheng and bells first sound as auspicious wind guides the clouds.

sentences.zh: 臣拜稽首兮中心孔勤，爰瞻寶輦兮森羅萬神。

translations.literal: The minister bows, head to ground — inner heart very earnest; thus gazing at the precious carriage — myriad spirits densely arrayed.
translations.idiomatic: The minister bows his head to the ground, heart deeply earnest; gazing at the precious carriage, myriad spirits stand arrayed.

sentences.zh: 庶幾昭格兮眷命其申，徘徊顧歆兮鑑我恭寅。

translations.literal: We hope perhaps for manifest presence — favoring command thereby extended; lingering, turning to enjoy — mirror our respectful reverence.
translations.idiomatic: We hope for clear descent, favor extended; lingering in acceptance, regard our respectful reverence.

sentences.zh: 奠玉帛，《肅和之曲》：捧珪幣兮瑤堂，穆將愉兮聖皇。

translations.literal: Offering jade and silk, "Reverent Harmony": bearing jade disks and silks in the jade hall; solemn, about to be pleased — the sage sovereign.
translations.idiomatic: Offering jade and silk — "Reverent Harmony": bearing jade disks and silks in the jade hall; solemn and pleased is the sage sovereign.

sentences.zh: 秉予心兮純一，荷帝德兮溥將。

translations.literal: Upholding my heart in pure unity; bearing the Emperor's virtue, broadly bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: We hold our hearts in pure unity, bearing the Emperor's virtue broadly bestowed.

sentences.zh: 進俎，《凝和之曲》：歲功阜兮庶類成，黍稷飶兮濡鼎馨。

translations.literal: Presenting the sacrifice tray, "Concentrated Harmony": year's merit abundant — all kinds completed; millet and grain fragrant — soaking the tripod, fragrant.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting the sacrifice tray — "Concentrated Harmony": the year's work is rich, all kinds complete; millet and grain fragrant, soaking the tripod with scent.

sentences.zh: 敬薦之兮慚菲輕，大禮不煩兮惟一誠。

translations.literal: Reverently presenting them — ashamed they are slight and light; the great rite is not troublesome — only one sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: We present them reverently, ashamed they are slight; the great rite asks no excess, only sincerity.

sentences.zh: 初獻，《壽和之曲》：金風動兮玉宇澄，初獻觴兮交聖靈。

translations.literal: First offering, "Longevity and Harmony": golden wind stirs — jade firmament clear; first offering goblet — communing with the sage spirit.
translations.idiomatic: First offering — "Longevity and Harmony": golden wind stirs, the jade heavens clear; the first goblet communes with the sage spirit.

sentences.zh: 瞻玄造兮懷鴻禎，曷以酬之心怦怦。

translations.literal: Gazing at the mysterious creation — cherishing great auspiciousness; with what shall we repay? The heart pounds and pounds.
translations.idiomatic: We gaze at the mysterious creation, cherishing great blessing; with what shall we repay? Our hearts pound.

sentences.zh: 亞獻，《豫和之曲》：帝眷我兮居歆，紛繁會兮五音。

translations.literal: Second offering, "Ease and Harmony": the Emperor favors us — dwelling in enjoyment; profuse gathering — the five tones.
translations.idiomatic: Second offering — "Ease and Harmony": the Emperor favors us and dwells in enjoyment; the five tones gather in profusion.

sentences.zh: 再捧觴兮莫殫臣心，惟帝欣懌兮生民是任。

translations.literal: Again bearing the goblet — never exhausting the minister's heart; only the Emperor joyful and pleased — the living people are entrusted.
translations.idiomatic: Again we bear the goblet, our hearts never exhausted; the Emperor is pleased and entrusts the living people.

sentences.zh: 終獻，《熙和之曲》：綏萬邦兮屢豐年，眇眇予躬兮實荷昊天。

translations.literal: Final offering, "Radiant Harmony": pacifying the ten thousand states — repeatedly abundant years; tiny, tiny is my person — truly bearing the vast Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Final offering — "Radiant Harmony": pacifying the myriad states, years repeatedly abundant; slight as I am, I truly bear Heaven's burden.

sentences.zh: 酒三獻兮心益虔，帝命參輿兮勿遽旋。

translations.literal: Wine three offerings — the heart grows ever more reverent; the Emperor commands the attendant carriage — do not hastily wheel back.
translations.idiomatic: Three wine offerings and our hearts grow ever more reverent; the Emperor commands the attendant carriage not to turn back hastily.

sentences.zh: 徹饌，《雍和之曲》：祀禮既洽兮神人肅雍，享帝享親兮勉歆臣衷。

translations.literal: Removing the feast, "Harmonious Peace": the sacrificial rite is already harmonious — spirit and human solemn and harmonious; enjoying the Emperor, enjoying kin — striving to accept the minister's heart.
translations.idiomatic: Removing the feast — "Harmonious Peace": the sacrifice is harmonious, spirit and human solemn; honoring Emperor and kin, accepting the minister's heart.

sentences.zh: 惟洪恩兮罔極，儼連蜷兮聖容。

translations.literal: Only vast grace is without limit; august, coiled and curled — the sage countenance.
translations.idiomatic: Vast grace is without limit; august and serene is the sage countenance.

sentences.zh: 送神，《清和之曲》：《九韶》既成兮金玉鏗鏘，百辟森立兮戚羽期藏。

translations.literal: Sending off the Spirit, "Clear Harmony": "Nine Shao" is already accomplished — gold and jade clang and ring; the hundred lords stand forest-dense — feather dancers about to be stored away.
translations.idiomatic: Sending off the Spirit — "Clear Harmony": the "Nine Shao" is complete, gold and jade ringing clear; the hundred lords stand in ranks, feather dancers ready to withdraw.

sentences.zh: 皇天在上兮昭考在旁，嚴父配天兮祗修厥常。

translations.literal: Imperial Heaven is above — illustrious forefather is at the side; stern father paired with Heaven — reverently maintaining its constant rite.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Heaven above, our illustrious forefather at our side; the stern father paired with Heaven, we reverently keep the eternal rite.

sentences.zh: 殷薦既終兮神去無方，玄雲上升兮鸞鵠參翔。

translations.literal: Abundant offerings are already ended — the spirit departs without direction; dark clouds rise upward — luan and swan soar together.
translations.idiomatic: Abundant offerings are complete and the spirit departs beyond knowing; dark clouds rise as luan and swan soar together.

sentences.zh: 靈光回照兮鬱乎芬芳，載慕載瞻兮願錫亨昌。

translations.literal: Spirit light reflects back — lush and fragrant; bearing longing, bearing gaze — we wish to be granted prosperity.
translations.idiomatic: Spirit light shines back, lush with fragrance; with longing we gaze and pray blessing and prosperity be granted.

sentences.zh: 子孫庶民兮惟帝是將，於昭明德兮永懷不忘。

translations.literal: Descendants and common people — only the Emperor do they follow; how bright is clear virtue — forever cherished, never forgotten.
translations.idiomatic: Descendants and common people follow the Emperor alone; how bright is His clear virtue — forever cherished, never forgotten.

sentences.zh: 望燎，《時和之曲》：龍輿杳杳兮歸上方，金風應律兮燎斯揚，達精誠兮合靈光。

translations.literal: Gazing at the burning, "Timely Harmony": the dragon carriage dim and far — returning to the heights above; golden wind answers the pitch — the burning is raised; reaching sincerity — merging with spirit light.
translations.idiomatic: Gazing at the burning — "Timely Harmony": the dragon carriage fades and returns above; golden wind answers the pitch and the flame rises; sincerity reaches forth and merges with spirit light.

sentences.zh: 帝廷納兮玉帛將，顧下土兮春不忘，願錫吾民兮長阜康。

translations.literal: The imperial court receives — jade and silk advance; looking down on the lower earth — spring is not forgotten; we wish to grant our people long abundance and peace.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial court receives jade and silk; looking down on the earth, spring is not forgotten; we pray our people may long enjoy abundance and peace.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖十八年，興都大饗樂章。

translations.literal: Eighteenth year of Jiajing — music for the Xingdu Great Feast.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing reign year 18: hymns for the Xingdu Great Feast.

sentences.zh: 迎神，《中和之曲》：仰高高之在上兮皇穹，冒九圍之遍覆兮罔止西東。

translations.literal: Welcoming the Spirit, "Moderation and Harmony": looking up — high above is the imperial vault; covering the nine orbits entirely — without stopping east or west.
translations.idiomatic: Welcoming the Spirit — "Moderation and Harmony": we look up to the high vault of Heaven; it covers the nine spheres entirely, without end east or west.

sentences.zh: 王者出王遊衍兮必奉天顧，愚臣之此行兮亶荷帡幪。

translations.literal: When the king goes forth on royal progress — he must receive Heaven's regard; this journey of the foolish minister — truly bearing protective grace.
translations.idiomatic: When the king goes forth on royal progress he must receive Heaven's regard; on this journey the foolish minister truly bears protective grace.

sentences.zh: 初獻，《壽和之曲》：於昭帝庥兮臣感恩淵淵，巡省舊籓之地兮實止承天。

translations.literal: First offering, "Longevity and Harmony": how clear is imperial grace — the minister's gratitude is deep and deep; touring the former fief land — truly stopping to receive Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: First offering — "Longevity and Harmony": how clear is imperial grace, and the minister's gratitude runs deep; touring his former fief, he truly halts to receive Heaven.

sentences.zh: 下情思報兮此心拳拳，瓊卮蒼幣兮捧扣壇前。

translations.literal: Lower feelings wish to repay — this heart is earnest and earnest; jade goblet and dark silks — held and struck before the altar.
translations.idiomatic: Our humble hearts wish to repay, earnest beyond measure; jade goblet and dark silks we hold before the altar.

sentences.zh: 亞獻，《敷和之曲》：樂奏兮三成，觴舉兮再呈。

translations.literal: Second offering, "Spread Harmony": music is performed — three movements; goblets are raised — twice presented.
translations.idiomatic: Second offering — "Spread Harmony": music sounds in three movements; goblets are raised and presented twice.

sentences.zh: 帝鑑幾微兮曰爾誠，小臣頓首兮敢不嚴於此精。

translations.literal: The Emperor mirrors subtlety — saying your sincerity; the small minister bows head to ground — how dare he not be strict in this refinement?
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor perceives our subtle hearts and calls us sincere; the humble minister bows his head — how dare he fail in this refinement?

sentences.zh: 終獻，《承和之曲》：臣來茲土，本之思親。

translations.literal: Final offering, "Receiving Harmony": the minister came to this land — rooted in thoughts of kin.
translations.idiomatic: Final offering — "Receiving Harmony": the minister came to this land, rooted in thoughts of kin.

sentences.zh: 思親伊何？

translations.literal: Thoughts of kin — for what?
translations.idiomatic: What are thoughts of kin for?

sentences.zh: 昌厥嗣人。

translations.literal: To bring prosperity to those who follow.
translations.idiomatic: To bring prosperity to those who follow.

sentences.zh: 嗣人克昌，菲戴帝之臨汝夫何因。

translations.literal: May those who follow flourish — how can the slight bear the Emperor's regard upon you? For what reason?
translations.idiomatic: May our heirs flourish; how can the humble bear the Emperor's regard upon you — for what merit?

sentences.zh: 徹饌，《永和之曲》：肅其具兮祀禮行，備彼儀兮樂舞張。

translations.literal: Removing the feast, "Eternal Harmony": solemn are the implements — the sacrificial rite proceeds; complete those rituals — music and dance are spread.
translations.idiomatic: Removing the feast — "Eternal Harmony": the implements stand solemn as the rite proceeds; every ritual is complete, music and dance unfold.

sentences.zh: 退省進止兮臣疏且狂，沐含仁兮何以量。

translations.literal: Retiring to reflect on advance and halt — the minister is coarse and wild; bathed in encompassing benevolence — how can it be measured?
translations.idiomatic: Retiring to reflect on what we have done, coarse and unrestrained is the minister; bathed in encompassing benevolence — how can it be measured?

sentences.zh: 送神，《感和之曲》：王之狩兮典有禋望，於維柴祀兮首重上蒼。

translations.literal: Sending off the Spirit, "Responsive Harmony": the king's hunt — the canon has prayer and gazing; at the faggot sacrifice — first esteem the upper azure.
translations.idiomatic: Sending off the Spirit — "Responsive Harmony": the king's hunt has its canon of prayer and gazing; at the faggot sacrifice we first honor the heavens above.

sentences.zh: 臣情罔殫兮夙夜惶惶，祗伸愚悃兮允賴恩光。

translations.literal: The minister's feeling is never exhausted — dawn and dusk anxious; only extending foolish sincerity — truly relying on grace-light.
translations.idiomatic: The minister's devotion never ends, anxious dawn to dusk; he offers only foolish sincerity, truly relying on grace-light.

sentences.zh: 遙瞻兮六龍騰翔，帝垂祉兮萬世永昌。

translations.literal: Gazing from afar — six dragons soar in flight; the Emperor lowers blessing — ten thousand ages eternally glorious.
translations.idiomatic: We gaze afar as six dragons soar; the Emperor bestows blessing and ten thousand ages flourish.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖十一年，定雩祀樂章，十七年罷。

translations.literal: Eleventh year of Jiajing — fixed the music for rain-prayer sacrifice; abolished in the seventeenth year.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing reign year 11: rain-prayer hymns were established; abolished in year 17.

sentences.zh: 迎神，《中和之曲》：於穆上帝，爰處瑤宮。

translations.literal: Welcoming the Spirit, "Moderation and Harmony": how solemn is the Supreme Lord — there dwelling in the jade palace.
translations.idiomatic: Welcoming the Spirit — "Moderation and Harmony": how solemn is the Supreme Lord, dwelling in the jade palace.

sentences.zh: 諮爾黎庶，覆憫曷窮。

translations.literal: I inform you, common people — covering pity without end.
translations.idiomatic: I speak to you, common people: His sheltering mercy has no end.

sentences.zh: 旗幢戾止，委蛇雲龍。

translations.literal: Banners and pennants arrive; winding serpent-like — cloud dragons.
translations.idiomatic: Banners and pennants have arrived; cloud dragons wind serpent-like.

sentences.zh: 霖澤斯溥，萬寶有終。

translations.literal: Rain moisture spreads broad; the myriad treasures have completion.
translations.idiomatic: Rain moisture spreads far and wide; the myriad treasures reach fulfillment.

sentences.zh: 奠幣，《肅和之曲》：神之格思，奠茲文纁。

translations.literal: Offering silks, "Reverent Harmony": the spirit draws near; offering these patterned scarlet silks.
translations.idiomatic: Offering silks — "Reverent Harmony": the spirit draws near; we offer these patterned scarlet silks.

sentences.zh: 盛樂斯舉，香氣氤氳。

translations.literal: Grand music is raised; incense vapor dense and swirling.
translations.idiomatic: Grand music rises; fragrant vapor swirls dense.

sentences.zh: 精禋孔，徹於紫冥。

translations.literal: Refined sacrifice burns bright; it reaches the purple darkness.
translations.idiomatic: Refined sacrifice burns bright, reaching the purple heavens.

sentences.zh: 懇祈膏澤，渥我嘉生。

translations.literal: Earnestly praying for moistening grace; enriching our fine life.
translations.idiomatic: We earnestly pray for nourishing rain to enrich our growing life.

sentences.zh: 進俎，《咸和之曲》：百川委潤，名山出云。

translations.literal: Presenting the sacrifice tray, "All Harmony": a hundred streams pour moisture; famous mountains send forth clouds.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting the sacrifice tray — "All Harmony": a hundred streams pour their moisture; famous mountains send forth clouds.

sentences.zh: 愆暘孔熾，膏澤斯屯。

translations.literal: Excess sun fiercely burns; moistening grace is pent up.
translations.idiomatic: Excess sun burns fiercely; nourishing rain is held back.

sentences.zh: 祈年於天，載牲於俎。

translations.literal: Praying for harvest year to Heaven; bearing victims on the tray.
translations.idiomatic: We pray for a good year to Heaven and bear victims on the tray.

sentences.zh: 神之格思，報以甘雨。

translations.literal: The spirit draws near; replying with sweet rain.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit draws near and answers with sweet rain.

sentences.zh: 初獻，《壽和之曲》：有嚴崇祀，日吉辰良。

translations.literal: First offering, "Longevity and Harmony": stern is the lofty sacrifice; the day is auspicious, the hour fine.
translations.idiomatic: First offering — "Longevity and Harmony": solemn is the lofty sacrifice, on an auspicious day at a propitious hour.

sentences.zh: 酌彼罍洗，椒馨飶香。

translations.literal: Pouring from those urns for washing; pepper fragrance, savory scent.
translations.idiomatic: We pour from the washing urns; pepper fragrance rises savory and sweet.

sentences.zh: 元功溥濟，時雨時暘。

translations.literal: Primal merit broadly aids; timely rain, timely sunshine.
translations.idiomatic: Primal merit aids all broadly; timely rain and timely sun.

sentences.zh: 惟神是聽，綏以多穰。

translations.literal: Only the spirit is heeded; pacified with abundant harvest.
translations.idiomatic: May the spirit hear us and grant abundant harvest.

sentences.zh: 亞獻，《景和之曲》：皇皇禋祀，孔惠孔明。

translations.literal: Second offering, "Scenic Harmony": august is the sacrificial rite; greatly gracious, greatly bright.
translations.idiomatic: Second offering — "Scenic Harmony": august is the sacrificial rite, full of grace and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 瞻仰來歆，拜首欽承。

translations.literal: Looking up — You come to enjoy; bowing head, reverently receiving.
translations.idiomatic: We look up as You come to accept; bowing our heads, we reverently receive.

sentences.zh: 有醴維醽，有酒維清，去韶侑獻，肅雍和鳴。

translations.literal: There is sweet wine and rich brew; there is wine clear; removing Shao music for the secondary offering — solemn, harmonious sounds ring.
translations.idiomatic: Sweet wine and rich brew, clear wine as well; Shao music yields to the secondary offering, solemn harmonious tones ring out.

sentences.zh: 聖靈有赫，鑑享精誠。

translations.literal: The sage spirit is blazing bright; mirrors and enjoys sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: The sage spirit blazes bright and regards our sincere devotion.

sentences.zh: 終獻，《永和之曲》：靈承無斁，駿奔有容。

translations.literal: Final offering, "Eternal Harmony": the spirit receives without satiety; earnest running has countenance.
translations.idiomatic: Final offering — "Eternal Harmony": the spirit receives without end; earnest runners bear dignified mien.

sentences.zh: 嘉玉以陳，酌鬯以供。

translations.literal: Fine jade is set forth; fragrant brew is poured for offering.
translations.idiomatic: Fine jade is set forth; fragrant brew is poured for offering.

sentences.zh: 禮三再稱，誠一以從。

translations.literal: The rite is thrice repeated; sincerity unified in following.
translations.idiomatic: The rite is proclaimed thrice; one sincerity guides all we do.

sentences.zh: 備物致志，申薦彌恭。

translations.literal: Preparing objects, expressing intent; presenting the offering ever more reverent.
translations.idiomatic: We prepare every object and express our intent, presenting the offering with ever greater reverence.

sentences.zh: 神昭景貺，佑我耕農。

translations.literal: The spirit manifests bright bounty; protecting our plowing farmers.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit manifests bright bounty and protects our farming people.

sentences.zh: 徹饌，《凝和之曲》：有赫旱，民勞瘁斯。

translations.literal: Removing the feast, "Concentrated Harmony": drought is prominent; the people toil in exhaustion.
translations.idiomatic: Removing the feast — "Concentrated Harmony": drought blazes fierce; the people toil in exhaustion.

sentences.zh: 於牲於醴，載舞載詩。

translations.literal: With victims and with wine — bearing dance, bearing verse.
translations.idiomatic: With victims and wine we dance and chant in devotion.

sentences.zh: 禮成三獻，敬徹不遲。

translations.literal: The rite completes with three offerings; reverently withdrawing without delay.
translations.idiomatic: Three offerings complete the rite; we withdraw reverently without delay.

sentences.zh: 神之聽之，雨我公私。

translations.literal: Spirit, hear this — rain on our public and private.
translations.idiomatic: Spirit, hear us — send rain on public fields and private alike.

sentences.zh: 送神，《清和之曲》：爰迪寅清，昭事昊穹。

translations.literal: Sending off the Spirit, "Clear Harmony": thus advancing dawn purity; manifest service to the vast vault.
translations.idiomatic: Sending off the Spirit — "Clear Harmony": thus we advance dawn purity and serve the vast heavens.

sentences.zh: 仰祈甘雨，惠我三農。

translations.literal: Looking up, praying for sweet rain; favoring our three agricultures.
translations.idiomatic: We look up and pray for sweet rain to bless our farmers.

sentences.zh: 既歆既格，言歸太空。

translations.literal: Already enjoyed, already come near — said to return to the great void.
translations.idiomatic: Having accepted and drawn near, the spirit returns to the great void.

sentences.zh: 式沾下土，萬方其同。

translations.literal: Thus moistening the lower earth; the ten thousand regions alike.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the lower earth is moistened, and every quarter shares alike.

sentences.zh: 望燎，《太和之曲》：赤龍旋馭，禮洽樂成。

translations.literal: Gazing at the burning, "Supreme Harmony": the crimson dragon wheels its carriage; rite harmonious, music complete.
translations.idiomatic: Gazing at the burning — "Supreme Harmony": the crimson dragon wheels its carriage; rite and music are complete.

sentences.zh: 燔燎既舉，昭格精禋。

translations.literal: The burning blaze is already raised; manifest presence of refined sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: The burning blaze is raised; the refined sacrifice draws clear presence.

sentences.zh: 維帝降康，雨施雲行。

translations.literal: Only the Emperor lowers peace; rain is bestowed, clouds move.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor bestows peace; rain is given and clouds move on.

sentences.zh: 登我黍稌，溥受厥明。

translations.literal: Ascending our millet and broomcorn; broadly receiving that brilliance.
translations.idiomatic: Our millet and broomcorn rise up, broadly receiving that brilliance.

sentences.zh: 祭畢，樂舞童羣歌《雲門之曲》：景龍精兮時見，測鶉緯兮宵懸。

translations.literal: Sacrifice complete — music-dance children in groups sing "Cloud Gate": auspicious dragon essence appears in season; measuring the Quail constellation — hung at night.
translations.idiomatic: When the sacrifice is done, children of the music-dance troupe sing "Cloud Gate": the auspicious dragon essence appears in season; the Quail constellation is measured, hung in the night sky.

sentences.zh: 肆廣樂兮鏗鍧，列皇舞兮蹁躚。

translations.literal: Spreading broad music — booming and ringing; arraying imperial dance — lightly tripping.
translations.idiomatic: Broad music resounds booming and clear; imperial dancers arrayed, lightly tripping.

sentences.zh: 祈方社兮不莫，薦圭璧兮孔虔。

translations.literal: Praying to the local altars — without dusk; offering jade disks and bi — most reverent.
translations.idiomatic: We pray at the local altars before dusk; we offer jade disks and bi with utmost reverence.

sentences.zh: 需密雲兮六漠，霈甘澍兮九玄。

translations.literal: Awaiting dense clouds over the six wastes; pouring sweet moisture over the nine dark heavens.
translations.idiomatic: We await dense clouds over the six wastes; sweet rain pours over the nine heavens.

sentences.zh: 慰我農兮既渥，錫明昭兮有年。

translations.literal: Comforting our farmers — already richly moistened; bestowing bright glory — a fruitful year.
translations.idiomatic: Our farmers are comforted, richly moistened; bright glory is granted — a year of plenty.

sentences.zh: 洪武元年，太社稷異壇同壝樂章。

translations.literal: First year of Hongwu — Grand Altar of Soil and Grain, separate mounds, same enclosure, music.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu reign year 1: hymns for the Grand Altar of Soil and Grain, separate mounds within one enclosure.

sentences.zh: 迎神，《廣和之曲》：五土之靈，百穀之英。

translations.literal: Welcoming the Spirit, "Broad Harmony": spirits of the five soils; essence of the hundred grains.
translations.idiomatic: Welcoming the Spirit — "Broad Harmony": spirits of the five soils, essence of the hundred grains.

sentences.zh: 國依土而寧，民以食而生。

translations.literal: The state relies on soil for peace; the people on food for life.
translations.idiomatic: The state rests on soil for peace; the people live by food.

sentences.zh: 基圖肇建，祀禮修明。

translations.literal: Foundation and design first established; sacrificial rite refined and bright.
translations.idiomatic: Foundation and design were first laid; sacrificial rites were refined and made bright.

sentences.zh: 神其來臨，肅恭而迎。

translations.literal: May the spirit come and approach; solemn and reverent in welcoming.
translations.idiomatic: May the spirit draw near; we welcome it with solemn reverence.

sentences.zh: 奠幣，《肅和之曲》：有國有人，社稷爲重。

translations.literal: Offering silks, "Reverent Harmony": having a state, having people — soil and grain are weighty.
translations.idiomatic: Offering silks — "Reverent Harmony": with state and people, soil and grain are paramount.

sentences.zh: 昭事雲初，玉帛虔奉。

translations.literal: Manifest service at the beginning of clouds; jade and silk reverently offered.
translations.idiomatic: We begin manifest service; jade and silk are reverently offered.

sentences.zh: 維物匪奇，敬實將之。

translations.literal: Only the objects are not strange; reverence and substance bear them forth.
translations.idiomatic: The offerings are not exotic; reverence and substance bear them forth.

sentences.zh: 以斯爲禮，冀達明祗。

translations.literal: Taking this as rite; hoping to reach the bright spirit.
translations.idiomatic: We take this as our rite, hoping to reach the bright spirit.

sentences.zh: 進俎，《凝和之曲》：崇壇北向，明禋方闡。

translations.literal: Presenting the sacrifice tray, "Concentrated Harmony": lofty altar facing north; bright sacrifice just opened.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting the sacrifice tray — "Concentrated Harmony": the lofty altar faces north; the bright sacrifice is newly opened.

sentences.zh: 有潔犧牲，禮因物顯。

translations.literal: There are pure sacrificial victims; the rite through objects is manifest.
translations.idiomatic: Pure victims stand ready; the rite shines forth through its offerings.

sentences.zh: 大房載設，中情以展。

translations.literal: The great vessel is fully set; inner feeling thereby expressed.
translations.idiomatic: The great vessel is fully set; our inner hearts are thereby expressed.

sentences.zh: 景運既承，神貺斯衍。

translations.literal: Auspicious fortune is already received; divine bounty spreads.
translations.idiomatic: Auspicious fortune is received; divine bounty spreads abroad.

sentences.zh: 初獻，《壽和之曲》：太社雲，高爲山林，深爲川澤。

translations.literal: First offering, "Longevity and Harmony": Grand Soil [says] — high becomes mountains and forests; deep becomes streams and marshes.
translations.idiomatic: First offering — "Longevity and Harmony": the Grand Altar of Soil — high it makes mountains and forests, deep it makes streams and marshes.

sentences.zh: 崇丘廣衍，亦有原隰。

translations.literal: Lofty hills spread wide; there are also plains and lowlands.
translations.idiomatic: Lofty hills spread wide; there are plains and lowlands as well.

sentences.zh: 惟神所司，百靈效職。

translations.literal: Only what the spirit oversees; the hundred numina perform their duties.
translations.idiomatic: What the spirit oversees, the hundred numina perform in duty.

sentences.zh: 清醴初陳，顒然昭格。

translations.literal: Clear wine is first set forth; uplifted, clearly manifest presence.
translations.idiomatic: Clear wine is first set forth; presence shines clear and uplifted.

sentences.zh: 句龍配雲，平治水土，萬世神功。

translations.literal: Gou Long paired [says]: leveling and governing water and soil — merit for ten thousand ages.
translations.idiomatic: Gou Long, paired in sacrifice — he leveled water and soil, merit for ten thousand ages.

sentences.zh: 民安物遂，造化攸同。

translations.literal: People secure, things fulfilled; creation and transformation alike.
translations.idiomatic: People are secure and things prosper; creation moves in harmony.

sentences.zh: 嘉惠無窮，報祀宜豐。

translations.literal: Fine favor without end; repaying sacrifice should be abundant.
translations.idiomatic: Fine favor is without end; our repaying sacrifice should be abundant.

sentences.zh: 配食尊嚴，國家所崇。

translations.literal: Paired in food, solemn and dignified — what state and family esteem.
translations.idiomatic: Paired in sacrifice, solemn and dignified — what state and family hold in esteem.

sentences.zh: 太稷雲，黍稷稻粱，來牟降祥，爲民之天。

translations.literal: Grand Grain [says]: millet, panicled millet, rice, and grain — black millet sends down blessing; it is the people's Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Altar of Grain — millet, panicled millet, rice, and grain; black millet sends blessing down; it is Heaven for the people.

sentences.zh: 豐年穰穰，其功甚大，其恩正長。

translations.literal: Abundant years, harvest rich; its merit is very great, its grace justly long.
translations.idiomatic: Years of plenty, harvest rich; its merit is great, its grace enduring.

sentences.zh: 乃登芳齊，以享以將。

translations.literal: Thus ascending fragrant offerings; to enjoy and to present.
translations.idiomatic: We ascend fragrant offerings to enjoy and present.

sentences.zh: 后稷配雲，皇皇后稷，克配於天。

translations.literal: Hou Ji paired [says]: august, august Hou Ji — able to be paired with Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Ji, paired in sacrifice — august Hou Ji, fit to be paired with Heaven.

sentences.zh: 誕降嘉種，樹藝大田。

translations.literal: He sent down fine seed; planting and cultivating the great fields.
translations.idiomatic: He sent down fine seed and planted the great fields.

sentences.zh: 生民粒食，功垂萬年。

translations.literal: Living people grain for food; merit hangs for ten thousand years.
translations.idiomatic: The living people eat grain; his merit endures ten thousand years.

sentences.zh: 建壇於京，歆茲吉蠲。

translations.literal: Building the altar in the capital; enjoying this auspicious purification.
translations.idiomatic: An altar was built in the capital; may it enjoy this auspicious purification.

sentences.zh: 亞獻，《豫和之曲》：太社雲，廣厚無偏，其體弘兮。

translations.literal: Second offering, "Ease and Harmony": Grand Soil [says] — broad and thick without partiality; its body is vast.
translations.idiomatic: Second offering — "Ease and Harmony": the Grand Altar of Soil — broad and thick, without partiality; its body is vast.

sentences.zh: 德侔坤順，萬物生兮。

translations.literal: Virtue equals Kun's yielding; the ten thousand things are born.
translations.idiomatic: Its virtue equals the yielding Earth; the ten thousand things are born.

sentences.zh: 錫民地利，神化行兮。

translations.literal: Bestowing on the people earthly advantage; divine transformation proceeds.
translations.idiomatic: It bestows earthly advantage on the people; divine transformation moves on.

sentences.zh: 恭祀告虔，國之禎兮。

translations.literal: Reverent sacrifice announces sincerity; the state's auspicious omen.
translations.idiomatic: Reverent sacrifice proclaims our sincerity — the state's auspicious sign.

sentences.zh: 句龍配雲，周覽四方，偉烈昭彰。

translations.literal: Gou Long paired [says]: surveying all four directions; great merit bright and manifest.
translations.idiomatic: Gou Long, paired in sacrifice — surveying all four quarters, great merit bright and manifest.

sentences.zh: 九州既平，五行有常。

translations.literal: The nine regions are already pacified; the Five Phases have their constant.
translations.idiomatic: The nine regions are pacified; the Five Phases run in order.

sentences.zh: 壇位以妥，牲醴之將。

translations.literal: Altar position thereby settled; victims and sweet wine about to be presented.
translations.idiomatic: The altar stands ready; victims and sweet wine are about to be presented.

sentences.zh: 是崇是嚴，煥然典章。

translations.literal: Thus we exalt, thus we hold strict; the canonical rites blaze forth clear.
translations.idiomatic: We exalt it and hold it strict; statute and rite shine forth in splendor.

sentences.zh: 太稷雲，億兆林林，所資者谷。

translations.literal: Grand Millet: the hundred millions stand in hosts — what they rely on is grain.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Millet: millions upon millions stand in hosts — grain sustains them all.

sentences.zh: 雨暘應時，家給人足。

translations.literal: Rain and sunshine respond in season; households are supplied and people are fulfilled.
translations.idiomatic: Rain and sunshine come in season; every household is supplied, every person fulfilled.

sentences.zh: 倉庾坻京，神介多福。

translations.literal: Granaries mound high as a capital; the spirit mediates abundant blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Granaries mound high as a capital; the spirit bestows abundant blessing.

sentences.zh: 祗薦其儀，昭事維肅。

translations.literal: In reverence we present the rite; the manifest service is wholly solemn.
translations.idiomatic: In reverence we offer the rite; the manifest service is wholly solemn.

sentences.zh: 后稷配雲，躬勤稼穡，有相之道。

translations.literal: Houji as associate: personally diligent in sowing and reaping, with a way to assist.
translations.idiomatic: Houji as associate: he labored in the fields himself, with a way to assist all.

sentences.zh: 不稂不莠，實堅實好。

translations.literal: No wild grass, no tares — the grain is firm and good.
translations.idiomatic: No wild grass, no tares — grain firm and fine.

sentences.zh: 農事開國，王基永保。

translations.literal: Farming opened the state; the royal foundation is forever kept.
translations.idiomatic: Farming opened the realm; the royal foundation is kept forever.

sentences.zh: 有年自今，常奉蘋藻。

translations.literal: From this year onward, we shall always offer pondweed and water-shield.
translations.idiomatic: From this year onward, may good harvests come — we shall always offer water-shield and pondweed.

sentences.zh: 終獻，《豫和之曲》，詞同亞獻。

translations.literal: Final offering, "Ease and Harmony" — the lyrics are the same as the second offering.
translations.idiomatic: Final offering — "Ease and Harmony"; the lyrics are the same as the second offering.

sentences.zh: 徹豆，《雍和之曲》：禮展其勤，樂奏其節。

translations.literal: Removing the beans, "Harmonious Peace": the rite displays its diligence; music plays its measure.
translations.idiomatic: Removing the beans — "Harmonious Peace": the rite displays its diligence; music keeps its measure.

sentences.zh: 庶品苾芬，神明是達。

translations.literal: The many offerings are fragrant and full; the spirits reach them.
translations.idiomatic: All offerings fragrant and full — the spirits reach them.

sentences.zh: 有嚴執事，俎豆乃徹。

translations.literal: Attendants stern in service; the trays and vessels are now withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: Attendants stern in duty; trays and vessels are now withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 穆穆雍雍，均其欣悅。

translations.literal: Solemn and serene, harmonious and calm — all share the same joy.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn and serene, harmonious and calm — all share the same joy.

sentences.zh: 送神，《安和之曲》：維壇潔清，維主堅貞。

translations.literal: Sending off the Spirit, "Secure Harmony": the altar alone is pure and clean; the sacrificer alone is firm and true.
translations.idiomatic: Sending off the Spirit — "Secure Harmony": the altar alone is pure and clean; the sacrificer alone is firm and true.

sentences.zh: 神之所歸，依茲以寧。

translations.literal: Where the spirit returns, here it finds rest.
translations.idiomatic: Where the spirit returns, here it finds rest.

sentences.zh: 土宇靖安，年穀順成。

translations.literal: The land and realm are tranquil; the year's grain ripens in order.
translations.idiomatic: The land is tranquil; the year's grain ripens in order.

sentences.zh: 祀事昭明，永致昇平。

translations.literal: The sacrifice shines clear; lasting rising peace is secured.
translations.idiomatic: The sacrifice shines clear; lasting peace is secured.

sentences.zh: 望瘞，《時和之曲》：晨光將發，既侑既歆。

translations.literal: Gazing at the burial, "Timely Harmony": dawn light is about to break; we have assisted and the spirit has accepted.
translations.idiomatic: Gazing at the burial — "Timely Harmony": dawn light is about to break; we have assisted and the spirit has accepted.

sentences.zh: 瘞茲牲幣，達於幽陰。

translations.literal: We bury these victims and silks, reaching the hidden yin realm.
translations.idiomatic: We bury these victims and silks, reaching the hidden yin realm.

sentences.zh: 神人和悅，實獲我心。

translations.literal: Spirit and human are alike pleased — my heart is truly won.
translations.idiomatic: Spirit and human are alike pleased — my heart is truly won.

sentences.zh: 永久禋祀，其始於今。

translations.literal: Everlasting sacrificial worship begins from this day.
translations.idiomatic: Everlasting sacrificial worship begins from this day.

sentences.zh: 洪武十一年，合祭太社稷樂章。

translations.literal: Hongwu year 11: hymns for the joint sacrifice to the Great Altars of Soil and Grain.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu year 11: hymns for the joint sacrifice to the Great Altars of Soil and Grain.

sentences.zh: 迎神，《廣和之曲》：予惟土谷兮造化工，爲民立命兮當報崇。

translations.literal: Welcoming the Spirit, "Broad Harmony": I consider the god of soil and grain who wrought creation's work; who set life for the people — I must repay in highest reverence.
translations.idiomatic: Welcoming the Spirit — "Broad Harmony": I consider the god of soil and grain who wrought creation's work; who set life for the people — I must repay in highest reverence.

sentences.zh: 民歌且舞兮朝雍雍，備筵率職兮候迓迎。

translations.literal: The people sing and dance in the morning, serene; we set the feast and lead the offices to wait and welcome.
translations.idiomatic: The people sing and dance through the serene morning; we set the feast and lead every office to wait and welcome.

sentences.zh: 想聖來兮祥風生，欽當稽首兮告年豐。

translations.literal: Thinking the sage comes, auspicious wind rises; I bow my head and report a bountiful year.
translations.idiomatic: When the sage spirit comes, auspicious wind rises; I bow low and report a year of plenty.

sentences.zh: 初獻，《壽和之曲》：氤氳氣合兮物遂蒙，民之立命兮荷陰功。

translations.literal: First offering, "Longevity and Harmony": vapors mingle and merge — things are covered; the people's allotted life bears yin merit.
translations.idiomatic: First offering — "Longevity and Harmony": mingling vapors enfold all things; the people's allotted lives bear the merit of yin.

sentences.zh: 予將玉帛兮獻微衷，初斟醴薦兮民福洪。

translations.literal: I will offer jade and silk to present my slight sincerity; first pouring sweet wine to present the people's great blessing.
translations.idiomatic: I offer jade and silk with humble sincerity; first pouring sweet wine to bring the people great blessing.

sentences.zh: 亞獻，《豫和之曲》：予令樂舞兮再捧觴，願神昭格兮軍民康。

translations.literal: Second offering, "Ease and Harmony": I command music and dance to raise the goblet again; may the spirit shine forth — army and people at peace.
translations.idiomatic: Second offering — "Ease and Harmony": I command music and dance to raise the goblet again; may the spirit shine forth — army and people at peace.

sentences.zh: 思必穆穆兮靈洋洋，感恩厚兮拜祥光。

translations.literal: Thought must be solemn; the spirit vast and bright; gratitude is deep — we bow to auspicious light.
translations.idiomatic: Thought must be solemn; the spirit vast and bright; deep gratitude — we bow to auspicious light.

sentences.zh: 終獻，《熙和之曲》：幹羽飛旋兮酒三行，香菸繚繞兮雲旌幢。

translations.literal: Final offering, "Radiant Harmony": feathered dancers whirl — wine three rounds; incense smoke curls — cloud banners and pennants.
translations.idiomatic: Final offering — "Radiant Harmony": feathered dancers whirl as wine goes three rounds; incense curls — cloud banners and pennants.

sentences.zh: 予今稽首兮忻且惶，神顏悅兮霞彩彰。

translations.literal: Now I bow my head, joyful yet awed; the spirit's face is pleased — rosy clouds blaze bright.
translations.idiomatic: Now I bow my head, joyful yet awed; the spirit's face is pleased — rosy clouds blaze bright.

sentences.zh: 徹饌，《雍和之曲》：粗陳微禮兮神喜將，琅然絲竹兮樂舞揚。

translations.literal: Removing the feast, "Harmonious Peace": roughly setting forth a slight rite — the spirit is pleased and about to accept; silk and bamboo ring clear — music and dance rise.
translations.idiomatic: Removing the feast — "Harmonious Peace": we set forth a modest rite — the spirit is pleased to accept; silk and bamboo ring clear — music and dance rise.

sentences.zh: 願祥普降兮遐邇方，烝民率土兮盡安康。

translations.literal: May auspicious blessing spread everywhere, near and far; all the people within the realm share perfect peace.
translations.idiomatic: May auspicious blessing spread everywhere, near and far; all the people within the realm share perfect peace.

sentences.zh: 送神，《安和之曲》：氤氳氤氳兮祥光張，龍車鳳輦兮駕飛揚。

translations.literal: Sending off the Spirit, "Secure Harmony": vapors mingle, auspicious light spreads; dragon carriage and phoenix palanquin ride flying aloft.
translations.idiomatic: Sending off the Spirit — "Secure Harmony": vapors mingle, auspicious light spreads; dragon carriage and phoenix palanquin ride flying aloft.

sentences.zh: 遙瞻稽首兮去何方，民福留兮時雨暘。

translations.literal: Gazing from afar I bow my head — whither do You go? The people's blessing remains — timely rain and sunshine.
translations.idiomatic: Gazing from afar I bow my head — whither do You go? The people's blessing remains — timely rain and sunshine.

sentences.zh: 望瘞，《時和之曲》：捧餚羞兮詣瘞方，鳴鑾率舞兮聲鏗鏘。

translations.literal: Gazing at the burial, "Timely Harmony": bearing delicacies to the burial place; bells ring and dancers lead — sound resounds clear.
translations.idiomatic: Gazing at the burial — "Timely Harmony": bearing delicacies to the burial place; bells ring and dancers lead — sound resounds clear.

sentences.zh: 思神納兮民福昂，予今稽首兮謝恩光。

translations.literal: Thinking the spirit accepts — the people's blessing rises high; now I bow my head and thank the light of grace.
translations.idiomatic: Thinking the spirit accepts — the people's blessing rises high; now I bow my head and thank the light of grace.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖十年，初立帝社稷樂章。

translations.literal: Jiajing year 10: first establishment of hymns for the Emperor's Altars of Soil and Grain.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing year 10: first establishment of hymns for the Emperor's Altars of Soil and Grain.

sentences.zh: 迎神，《時和之曲》：東風兮地脈以融，首務兮稼穡之工。

translations.literal: Welcoming the Spirit, "Timely Harmony": east wind — the earth's pulse melts; first task — the work of sowing and reaping.
translations.idiomatic: Welcoming the Spirit — "Timely Harmony": east wind — the earth's pulse melts; first task — the work of sowing and reaping.

sentences.zh: 秋祭云：「金風兮萬寶以充，忻成兮稼穡之工。

translations.literal: The autumn sacrifice reads: "Golden wind — the myriad treasures are full; joy in completion — the work of sowing and reaping.
translations.idiomatic: The autumn sacrifice reads: "Golden wind — the myriad treasures are full; joy in completion — the work of sowing and reaping.

sentences.zh: 祀神於此兮苑中，願來格兮慰予衷。

translations.literal: We sacrifice to the spirit here in the garden; may You come and comfort my heart.
translations.idiomatic: We sacrifice to the spirit here in the garden; may You come and comfort my heart.

sentences.zh: 初獻，《壽和之曲》：神兮臨止，禮薦清醇。

translations.literal: First offering, "Longevity and Harmony": Spirit, You have come and halted; the rite presents clear pure wine.
translations.idiomatic: First offering — "Longevity and Harmony": Spirit, You have come and halted; the rite presents clear pure wine.

sentences.zh: 菲幣在笥，初獻式遵。

translations.literal: Humble silks are in the basket; the first offering follows the rule.
translations.idiomatic: Humble silks are in the basket; the first offering follows the rule.

sentences.zh: 神其鑑茲，享斯藻蘋。

translations.literal: Spirit, inspect this; enjoy these pondweed offerings.
translations.idiomatic: Spirit, inspect this; enjoy these pondweed offerings.

sentences.zh: 我祀伊何？

translations.literal: What is our sacrifice for?
translations.idiomatic: What is our sacrifice for?

sentences.zh: 祈報是因。

translations.literal: Prayer and thanksgiving are the reason.
translations.idiomatic: Prayer and thanksgiving are the reason.

sentences.zh: 神兮錫祉，則阜吾民。

translations.literal: Spirit, bestow blessing — then enrich our people.
translations.idiomatic: Spirit, bestow blessing — then enrich our people.

sentences.zh: 亞獻。

translations.literal: Second offering.
translations.idiomatic: Second offering.

sentences.zh: 《雍和之曲》：二觴載舉，中此殷勤。

translations.literal: "Harmonious Peace": two goblets are raised; between them this earnest care.
translations.idiomatic: "Harmonious Peace": two goblets are raised; between them this earnest care.

sentences.zh: 神悅兮以納，祥靄兮氤氳。

translations.literal: The spirit is pleased and accepts; auspicious mist mingles and merges.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit is pleased and accepts; auspicious mist mingles and merges.

sentences.zh: 終獻，《寧和之曲》：禮終兮酒三行，喜茂實兮黍稷粱。

translations.literal: Final offering, "Tranquil Harmony": the rite ends — wine three rounds; we rejoice in plump fruit — millet, panic grass, and grain.
translations.idiomatic: Final offering — "Tranquil Harmony": the rite ends — wine three rounds; we rejoice in plump fruit — millet, panic grass, and grain.

sentences.zh: 農事待兮豐康，予稽首兮以望。

translations.literal: Farming awaits abundance and peace; I bow my head and look up in hope.
translations.idiomatic: Farming awaits abundance and peace; I bow my head and look up in hope.

sentences.zh: 徹饌，《保和之曲》：祀事告終，三獻既周。

translations.literal: Removing the feast, "Preserving Harmony": the sacrifice announces its end; three offerings are complete.
translations.idiomatic: Removing the feast — "Preserving Harmony": the sacrifice announces its end; three offerings are complete.

sentences.zh: 徹之罔遲，惠注田疇。

translations.literal: Withdrawal is not delayed; favor pours upon the fields.
translations.idiomatic: Withdrawal is not delayed; favor pours upon the fields.

sentences.zh: 迓以休貺，庇茲有秋。

translations.literal: We welcome the fine gift; may it shelter this harvest season.
translations.idiomatic: We welcome the fine gift; may it shelter this harvest season.

sentences.zh: 送神，《廣和之曲》：耕耨伊首，秋祭云：「耕耨告就。

translations.literal: Sending off the Spirit, "Broad Harmony": plowing and hoeing come first; the autumn sacrifice reads: "Plowing and hoeing are announced complete.
translations.idiomatic: Sending off the Spirit — "Broad Harmony": plowing and hoeing come first; the autumn sacrifice reads: "Plowing and hoeing are announced complete.

sentences.zh: 」力事豆籩。

translations.literal: " With diligent effort we attend the beans and baskets.
translations.idiomatic: " With diligent care we tend the beans and baskets.

sentences.zh: 粢盛賴之，於此大田。

translations.literal: The grain offerings rely on this — here in the great field.
translations.idiomatic: The grain offerings rely on this — here in the great field.

sentences.zh: 予將以祀，神其少延。

translations.literal: I am about to sacrifice; Spirit, linger a little.
translations.idiomatic: I am about to sacrifice; Spirit, linger a little.

sentences.zh: 願留嘉祉，副我潔虔。

translations.literal: May You leave fine blessing to match my pure reverence.
translations.idiomatic: May You leave fine blessing to match my pure reverence.

sentences.zh: 肅駕兮雲旋，普予兮有年。

translations.literal: Solemn carriage wheels through the clouds; may all receive a good year.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn carriage wheels through the clouds; may all receive a good year.

sentences.zh: 望瘞，曲同。

translations.literal: Gazing at the burial — the tune is the same.
translations.idiomatic: Gazing at the burial — the tune is the same.

sentences.zh: 洪武二年，分祀天神地祇樂章。

translations.literal: Hongwu year 2: hymns for the separate sacrifice to the Spirits of Heaven and Earth.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu year 2: hymns for the separate sacrifice to the Spirits of Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 迎天神，奏《中和之曲》：吉目良辰，祀典式陳。

translations.literal: Welcoming the Spirits of Heaven, playing "Moderation and Harmony": auspicious day, propitious hour — the sacrificial canon is formally set forth.
translations.idiomatic: Welcoming the Spirits of Heaven, playing "Moderation and Harmony": auspicious day, propitious hour — the sacrificial canon is formally set forth.

sentences.zh: 太歲尊神，雷雨風云。

translations.literal: The Grand Year honored spirit, thunder, rain, wind, and cloud.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Year honored spirit, thunder, rain, wind, and cloud.

sentences.zh: 濯濯厥靈，昭鑑我心。

translations.literal: Abundant is their spirit; they illuminate and mirror my heart.
translations.idiomatic: Abundant is their spirit; they illuminate and mirror my heart.

sentences.zh: 以候以迎，來格來歆。

translations.literal: We wait and we welcome; come and accept, come and enjoy.
translations.idiomatic: We wait and we welcome; come and accept, come and enjoy.

sentences.zh: 奠帛以後，鹹同朝日。

translations.literal: After offering silks, all is the same as for the Morning Sun.
translations.idiomatic: After offering silks, all is the same as for the Morning Sun.

sentences.zh: 迎地祇，奏《中和之曲》：吉日良辰，祀典式陳。

translations.literal: Welcoming the Spirits of Earth, playing "Moderation and Harmony": auspicious day, propitious hour — the sacrificial canon is formally set forth.
translations.idiomatic: Welcoming the Spirits of Earth, playing "Moderation and Harmony": auspicious day, propitious hour — the sacrificial canon is formally set forth.

sentences.zh: 惟地之祇，百靈繽紛。

translations.literal: Only the spirits of earth — the hundred spirits in splendid array.
translations.idiomatic: Only the spirits of earth — the hundred spirits in splendid array.

sentences.zh: 嶽鎮海瀆，山川城隍，內而中國，外及四方。

translations.literal: Peaks, famous mountains, seas and rivers, mountains and streams, city gods — within the Middle Kingdom, beyond to the four quarters.
translations.idiomatic: Peaks, famous mountains, seas and rivers, mountains and streams, city gods — within the Middle Kingdom, beyond to the four quarters.

sentences.zh: 洪武六年，合祀天神地祗樂章。

translations.literal: Hongwu year 6: hymns for the joint sacrifice to the Spirits of Heaven and Earth.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu year 6: hymns for the joint sacrifice to the Spirits of Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 迎神，《保和之曲》：吉日良辰，祀典式陳。

translations.idiomatic: Welcoming the Spirit — "Preserving Harmony": auspicious day, propitious hour — the sacrificial canon is formally set forth.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖九年，復分祀天神地祇樂章。

translations.literal: Jiajing year 9: hymns restored for the separate sacrifice to the Spirits of Heaven and Earth.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing year 9: hymns restored for the separate sacrifice to the Spirits of Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 迎天神，《保和之曲》：吉日良辰，祀典式陳。

translations.literal: Welcoming the Spirits of Heaven, "Preserving Harmony": auspicious day, propitious hour — the sacrificial canon is formally set forth.
translations.idiomatic: Welcoming the Spirits of Heaven — "Preserving Harmony": auspicious day, propitious hour — the sacrificial canon is formally set forth.

sentences.zh: 景靈甘雨，風雷之神。

translations.literal: The radiant spirit, sweet rain, and the gods of wind and thunder.
translations.idiomatic: The radiant spirit, sweet rain, and the gods of wind and thunder.

sentences.zh: 赫赫其靈，功著生民。

translations.literal: Blazing bright is their spirit; their merit shines upon the living people.
translations.idiomatic: Blazing bright is their spirit; their merit shines upon the living people.

sentences.zh: 參贊玄化，宣佈蒼仁。

translations.literal: They assist the dark transformation and spread azure benevolence.
translations.idiomatic: They assist the dark transformation and spread azure benevolence.

sentences.zh: 爰茲報祀，鑑斯藻蘋。

translations.literal: Here we make this responsive sacrifice; inspect these pondweed offerings.
translations.idiomatic: Here we make this responsive sacrifice; inspect these pondweed offerings.

sentences.zh: 奠帛以後，俱如舊。

translations.literal: After offering silks, all follows the former practice.
translations.idiomatic: After offering silks, all follows the former practice.

translations.literal: Welcoming the Spirits of Earth, "Preserving Harmony": auspicious day, propitious hour — the sacrificial canon is formally set forth.
translations.idiomatic: Welcoming the Spirits of Earth — "Preserving Harmony": auspicious day, propitious hour — the sacrificial canon is formally set forth.

sentences.zh: 靈嶽方鎮，海瀆之神，京畿四方，山澤羣真。

translations.literal: Spirit peaks and regional mounts, gods of seas and rivers; the capital region and four quarters, mountain and marsh spirits true.
translations.idiomatic: Spirit peaks and regional mounts, gods of seas and rivers; the capital region and four quarters, mountain and marsh spirits true.

sentences.zh: 毓靈分隅，福我生民。

translations.literal: They nurture spirit and divide the corners — bless our living people.
translations.idiomatic: They nurture spirit and divide the corners — bless our living people.

sentences.zh: 薦斯享報，鑑我恭寅。

translations.literal: We present this offering in response; inspect our reverent service.
translations.idiomatic: We present this offering in response; inspect our reverent service.

sentences.zh: 奠帛以後，亦如舊。

translations.literal: After offering silks, likewise as before.
translations.idiomatic: After offering silks, likewise as before.

sentences.zh: 洪武四年，祀周天星辰樂章。

translations.literal: Hongwu year 4: hymns for the sacrifice to the stars of the entire heavens.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu year 4: hymns for the sacrifice to the stars of the entire heavens.

sentences.zh: 迎神，《凝和之曲》：星辰垂象，佈列玄穹，擇茲吉日，祀禮是崇。

translations.literal: Welcoming the Spirit, "Concentrated Harmony": stars hang their signs, arrayed across the dark vault; on this chosen auspicious day, the sacrificial rite is honored.
translations.idiomatic: Welcoming the Spirit — "Concentrated Harmony": stars hang their signs, arrayed across the dark vault; on this chosen auspicious day, the sacrificial rite is honored.

translations.literal: Abundant is their spirit; they illuminate and mirror my heart.
translations.idiomatic: Abundant is their spirit; they illuminate and mirror my heart.

sentences.zh: 謹候以迎，庶幾來歆。

translations.literal: We reverently wait and welcome; may they come and accept.
translations.idiomatic: We reverently wait and welcome; may they come and accept.

sentences.zh: 奠帛，《保和之曲》，詞同朝日。

translations.literal: Offering silks, "Preserving Harmony" — the lyrics are the same as for the Morning Sun.
translations.idiomatic: Offering silks — "Preserving Harmony"; the lyrics are the same as for the Morning Sun.

sentences.zh: 初獻，《保和之曲》：神兮既留，品物斯薦。

translations.literal: First offering, "Preserving Harmony": Spirit, You have already remained; all things are now presented.
translations.idiomatic: First offering — "Preserving Harmony": Spirit, You have already remained; all things are now presented.

sentences.zh: 奉禮之初，醴酒斯奠。

translations.literal: At the beginning of performing the rite, sweet wine is now offered.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of performing the rite, sweet wine is now offered.

sentences.zh: 仰惟靈耀，以享以歆。

translations.literal: Looking up to the spirit's radiance — to enjoy and to accept.
translations.idiomatic: Looking up to the spirit's radiance — to enjoy and to accept.

sentences.zh: 何以侑觴？

translations.literal: With what shall we assist the goblet?
translations.idiomatic: With what shall we assist the goblet?

sentences.zh: 樂奏八音。

translations.literal: Music plays the eight tones.
translations.idiomatic: Music plays the eight tones.

sentences.zh: 亞獻，《中和之曲》：神既初享，亞獻再升。

translations.literal: Second offering, "Moderation and Harmony": the spirit has first enjoyed; the second offering is raised again.
translations.idiomatic: Second offering — "Moderation and Harmony": the spirit has first enjoyed; the second offering is raised again.

sentences.zh: 以酌醴齊，仰薦於神。

translations.literal: Pouring the pure wine, we offer it upward to the spirit.
translations.idiomatic: Pouring the pure wine, we offer it upward to the spirit.

sentences.zh: 洋洋在上，式燕以寧。

translations.literal: Vast and ample above, a feast to bring peace.
translations.idiomatic: Vast and ample above, a feast to bring peace.

sentences.zh: 庶表微衷，交於神明。

translations.literal: May this express our slight sincerity; communion with the spirits.
translations.idiomatic: May this express our slight sincerity; communion with the spirits.

sentences.zh: 終獻，《肅和之曲》：神既再享，終獻斯備。

translations.literal: Final offering, "Reverent Harmony": the spirit has enjoyed again; the final offering is now complete.
translations.idiomatic: Final offering — "Reverent Harmony": the spirit has enjoyed again; the final offering is now complete.

sentences.zh: 不腆菲儀，式將其意。

translations.literal: Though our offering is not ample, we convey our intent.
translations.idiomatic: Though our offering is not ample, we convey our intent.

sentences.zh: 薦茲酒醴，成我常祀。

translations.literal: We present this wine and rich brew; we complete our constant sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: We present this wine and rich brew; we complete our constant sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 神其顧歆，永言樂只。

translations.literal: Spirit, look down and accept; forever joyful.
translations.idiomatic: Spirit, look down and accept; forever joyful.

sentences.zh: 徹豆，《豫和之曲》：祀事將畢，神既歆只。

translations.literal: Removing the beans, "Ease and Harmony": the sacrifice is about to end; the spirit has already accepted.
translations.idiomatic: Removing the beans — "Ease and Harmony": the sacrifice is about to end; the spirit has already accepted.

sentences.zh: 徹茲俎豆，以成其禮。

translations.literal: We withdraw these trays and vessels to complete the rite.
translations.idiomatic: We withdraw these trays and vessels to complete the rite.

sentences.zh: 惟神樂欣，無間始終。

translations.literal: Only the spirit rejoices in delight — without break from beginning to end.
translations.idiomatic: Only the spirit rejoices in delight — without break from beginning to end.

sentences.zh: 樂音再作，庶在微悰。

translations.literal: Music sounds again; may it reach our slight sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: Music sounds again; may it reach our slight sincerity.

translations.idiomatic: Sending off the Spirit — "Harmonious Peace"; the lyrics are the same as for the Morning Sun.

sentences.zh: 望燎，《雍和之曲》：神既享祀，靈馭今旋。

translations.literal: Gazing at the burning, "Harmonious Peace": the spirit has already enjoyed the sacrifice; the spirit carriage now turns homeward.
translations.idiomatic: Gazing at the burning — "Harmonious Peace": the spirit has already enjoyed the sacrifice; the spirit carriage now turns homeward.

sentences.zh: 燎煙既升，神帛斯焚。

translations.literal: Burning smoke has risen; spirit silks are now consumed.
translations.idiomatic: Burning smoke has risen; spirit silks are now consumed.

sentences.zh: 巍巍霄漢，倏焉以適。

translations.literal: Towering in the azure heavens, suddenly they depart.
translations.idiomatic: Towering in the azure heavens, suddenly they depart.

sentences.zh: 拳拳餘衷，瞻望弗及。

translations.literal: Earnest is our remaining heart; we gaze after but cannot reach.
translations.idiomatic: Earnest is our remaining heart; we gaze after but cannot reach.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖八年，祀太歲月將樂章。

translations.literal: Jiajing year 8: hymns for the sacrifice to the Grand Year and Monthly Generals.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing year 8: hymns for the sacrifice to the Grand Year and Monthly Generals.

sentences.zh: 迎神：吉日良辰，祀典式陳。

translations.literal: Welcoming the Spirit: auspicious day, propitious hour — the sacrificial canon is formally set forth.
translations.idiomatic: Welcoming the Spirit: auspicious day, propitious hour — the sacrificial canon is formally set forth.

sentences.zh: 輔國佑民，太歲尊神。

translations.literal: Assisting the state and protecting the people — the Grand Year honored spirit.
translations.idiomatic: Assisting the state and protecting the people — the Grand Year honored spirit.

sentences.zh: 四時月將，功曹司辰。

translations.literal: The four seasons' monthly generals and the clerks of merit who keep the hours.
translations.idiomatic: The four seasons' monthly generals and the clerks of merit who keep the hours.

sentences.zh: 濯濯厥靈，昭鑑我心。

translations.literal: Abundant is their spirit; they illuminate and mirror my heart.
translations.idiomatic: Abundant is their spirit; they illuminate and mirror my heart.

sentences.zh: 以候以迎，來格來歆。

translations.literal: We wait and we welcome; come and accept, come and enjoy.
translations.idiomatic: We wait and we welcome; come and accept, come and enjoy.

sentences.zh: 奠帛以後，俱同神祇。

translations.literal: After offering silks, all is the same as for the Spirits of Heaven and Earth.
translations.idiomatic: After offering silks, all is the same as for the Spirits of Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 洪武元年宗廟樂章。

translations.literal: Hongwu year 1: hymns for the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu year 1: hymns for the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 迎神，《太和之曲》：慶源發祥，世德惟崇。

translations.literal: Welcoming the Spirit, "Supreme Harmony": the source of blessing sends forth auspicious omens; generations of virtue are honored.
translations.idiomatic: Welcoming the Spirit — "Supreme Harmony": the source of blessing sends forth auspicious omens; generations of virtue are honored.

sentences.zh: 致我眇躬，開基建功。

translations.literal: To my slight person — opening the foundation and establishing merit.
translations.idiomatic: To my slight person — opening the foundation and establishing merit.

sentences.zh: 京都之中，親廟在東。

translations.literal: Within the capital, the ancestral temple lies to the east.
translations.idiomatic: Within the capital, the ancestral temple lies to the east.

sentences.zh: 惟我子孫，永懷祖風。

translations.literal: Only we descendants forever cherish our ancestors' ways.
translations.idiomatic: Only we descendants forever cherish our ancestors' ways.

sentences.zh: 氣體則同，呼吸相通。

translations.literal: Our breath is the same; our breathing communicates.
translations.idiomatic: Our breath is the same; our breathing communicates.

sentences.zh: 來格來崇，皇靈顯融。

translations.literal: Come and accept, come and honor; the imperial spirit shines forth and merges.
translations.idiomatic: Come and accept, come and honor; the imperial spirit shines forth and merges.

sentences.zh: 奉冊寶，《熙和之曲》：時享不用維水有源，維木有根。

translations.literal: Presenting registers and treasures, "Radiant Harmony": seasonal offerings do not use this — water has its source, wood has its root.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting registers and treasures — "Radiant Harmony": seasonal offerings do not use this — water has its source, wood has its root.

sentences.zh: 先世積善，福垂後昆。

translations.literal: Former generations accumulated goodness; blessing extends to later generations.
translations.idiomatic: Former generations accumulated goodness; blessing extends to later generations.

sentences.zh: 冊寶鏤玉，德顯名尊。

translations.literal: Registers and treasures carved in jade — virtue displayed, name honored.
translations.idiomatic: Registers and treasures carved in jade — virtue displayed, name honored.

sentences.zh: 祗奉禮文，仰答洪恩。

translations.literal: In reverence we perform the ritual text; looking up we answer the great grace.
translations.idiomatic: In reverence we perform the ritual text; looking up we answer the great grace.

sentences.zh: 進俎，《凝和之曲》：時享不用明明祖考，妥神清廟。

translations.literal: Presenting the sacrifice tray, "Concentrated Harmony": seasonal offerings do not use this — bright, bright ancestral fathers; the spirit rests in the clear temple.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting the sacrifice tray — "Concentrated Harmony": seasonal offerings do not use this — bright, bright ancestral fathers; the spirit rests in the clear temple.

sentences.zh: 薦以牲牷，匪雲盡孝。

translations.literal: We present ox and sheep — not to say we exhaust filial piety.
translations.idiomatic: We present ox and sheep — not to say we exhaust filial piety.

sentences.zh: 願通神明，願成治效。

translations.literal: May we reach the spirits; may we achieve governing effect.
translations.idiomatic: May we reach the spirits; may we achieve governing effect.

sentences.zh: 此帝王之道，亦祖考之教。

translations.literal: This is the way of emperors and kings — also the teaching of ancestors and fathers.
translations.idiomatic: This is the way of emperors and kings — also the teaching of ancestors and fathers.

sentences.zh: 初獻，《壽和之曲》：德祖廟，初獻云：思皇高祖，穆然深玄。

translations.literal: First offering, "Longevity and Harmony": Virtue Ancestor Temple — the first offering reads: thinking of the august High Ancestor, solemn and deep and dark.
translations.idiomatic: First offering — "Longevity and Harmony": Virtue Ancestor Temple — the first offering reads: thinking of the august High Ancestor, solemn and deep and dark.

sentences.zh: 其遠歷年，其神在天。

translations.literal: So far in years, so high in spirit — in Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: So far in years, so high in spirit — in Heaven.

sentences.zh: 尊臨太室，餘慶綿綿。

translations.literal: Honored in the Grand Chamber — remaining blessing stretches on.
translations.idiomatic: Honored in the Grand Chamber — remaining blessing stretches on.

sentences.zh: 歆於几筵，有永其傳。

translations.literal: Accepted at the spirit table — may the transmission endure.
translations.idiomatic: Accepted at the spirit table — may the transmission endure.

sentences.zh: 懿祖廟初獻云：思皇曾祖，清勤純古。

translations.literal: Yi Ancestor Temple first offering reads: thinking of the august Great-Grandfather, pure, diligent, and wholly ancient.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Ancestor Temple first offering reads: thinking of the august Great-Grandfather, pure, diligent, and wholly ancient.

sentences.zh: 田裏韜光，天篤其祜。

translations.literal: In the fields he hid his light; Heaven was earnest in his blessing.
translations.idiomatic: In the fields he hid his light; Heaven was earnest in his blessing.

sentences.zh: 佑我曾孫，弘開土宇。

translations.literal: He aided me, his great-grandson, and broadly opened the realm.
translations.idiomatic: He aided me, his great-grandson, and broadly opened the realm.

sentences.zh: 追遠竭虔，勉遵前矩。

translations.literal: Pursuing the distant with utmost reverence, we strive to follow former measure.
translations.idiomatic: Pursuing the distant with utmost reverence, we strive to follow former measure.

sentences.zh: 熙祖廟初獻云：維我皇祖，淑後貽謀。

translations.literal: Xi Ancestor Temple first offering reads: our august imperial grandfather — a good consort bequeathed the plan.
translations.idiomatic: Xi Ancestor Temple first offering reads: our august imperial grandfather — a good consort bequeathed the plan.

sentences.zh: 盛德靈長，與泗同流。

translations.literal: Sublime virtue lingers long — it flows with the Si River.
translations.idiomatic: Sublime virtue lingers long — it flows with the Si River.

sentences.zh: 發於孫枝，明禋載修。

translations.literal: Issuing from the branch of descendants, bright sacrifice is ever maintained.
translations.idiomatic: Issuing from the branch of descendants, bright sacrifice is ever maintained.

sentences.zh: 嘉潤如海，恩何以酬。

translations.literal: Fine blessing like the sea — how can grace be repaid?
translations.idiomatic: Fine blessing like the sea — how can grace be repaid?

sentences.zh: 仁祖廟初獻云：惟我皇考，既淳且仁。

translations.literal: Ren Ancestor Temple first offering reads: our august imperial father — both pure and benevolent.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Ancestor Temple first offering reads: our august imperial father — both pure and benevolent.

sentences.zh: 弗耀其身，克開嗣人。

translations.literal: He did not display himself; he was able to open the succession.
translations.idiomatic: He did not display himself; he was able to open the succession.

sentences.zh: 子有天下，尊歸於親。

translations.literal: The son has all under Heaven; honor returns to kin.
translations.idiomatic: The son has all under Heaven; honor returns to kin.

sentences.zh: 景運維新，則有其因。

translations.literal: The age's fortune is renewed — thus there is cause.
translations.idiomatic: The age's fortune is renewed — thus there is cause.

sentences.zh: 亞獻，《豫和之曲》：對越至親，儼然如生。

translations.literal: Second offering, "Ease and Harmony": facing the most intimate kin, solemn as if alive.
translations.idiomatic: Second offering — "Ease and Harmony": facing the most intimate kin, solemn as if alive.

sentences.zh: 其氣昭明，感格在庭。

translations.literal: Their spirit is bright and clear; sympathetic response is in the court.
translations.idiomatic: Their spirit is bright and clear; sympathetic response is in the court.

sentences.zh: 如見其形，如聞其聲。

translations.literal: As if seeing their form, as if hearing their voice.
translations.idiomatic: As if seeing their form, as if hearing their voice.

sentences.zh: 愛而敬之，發乎中情。

translations.literal: Loving and revering them — it arises from the heart's center.
translations.idiomatic: Loving and revering them — it arises from the heart's center.

sentences.zh: 終獻，《熙和之曲》：承先人之德，化家爲國。

translations.literal: Final offering, "Radiant Harmony": inheriting the virtue of forebears, transforming family into state.
translations.idiomatic: Final offering — "Radiant Harmony": inheriting the virtue of forebears, transforming family into state.

sentences.zh: 毋曰予小子，基命成績。

translations.literal: Do not say "I, the young son" — the foundation mandate and accomplished merit.
translations.idiomatic: Do not say "I, the young son" — the foundation mandate and accomplished merit.

sentences.zh: 欲報其德，昊天罔極。

translations.literal: Wishing to repay their virtue — the vast Heaven has no limit.
translations.idiomatic: Wishing to repay their virtue — the vast Heaven has no limit.

sentences.zh: 殷勤三獻，我心悅懌。

translations.literal: Earnestly three offerings — my heart is pleased and at ease.
translations.idiomatic: Earnestly three offerings — my heart is pleased and at ease.

sentences.zh: 徹豆，《雍和之曲》：樂奏具肅，神其燕嬉。

translations.literal: Removing the beans, "Harmonious Peace": music is played, all solemn; may the spirit feast and rejoice.
translations.idiomatic: Removing the beans — "Harmonious Peace": music is played, all solemn; may the spirit feast and rejoice.

sentences.zh: 告成於祖，亦右皇妣。

translations.literal: We announce completion to the ancestors; we also honor the imperial consort.
translations.idiomatic: We announce completion to the ancestors; we also honor the imperial consort.

sentences.zh: 敬徹不遲，以終祀禮。

translations.literal: Reverent withdrawal without delay — to end the sacrificial rite.
translations.idiomatic: Reverent withdrawal without delay — to end the sacrificial rite.

sentences.zh: 祥光煥揚，錫以嘉祉。

translations.literal: Auspicious light blazes forth; blessing is bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: Auspicious light blazes forth; blessing is bestowed.

sentences.zh: 送神，《安和之曲》：顯兮幽兮，神運無跡。

translations.literal: Sending off the Spirit, "Secure Harmony": manifest yet hidden — the spirit's movement leaves no trace.
translations.idiomatic: Sending off the Spirit — "Secure Harmony": manifest yet hidden — the spirit's movement leaves no trace.

sentences.zh: 鸞馭逍遙，安其所適。

translations.literal: The phoenix carriage roams free; it rests where it is due.
translations.idiomatic: The phoenix carriage roams free; it rests where it is due.

sentences.zh: 其靈在天，其主在室。

translations.literal: Its spirit is in Heaven; its seat is in the chamber.
translations.idiomatic: Its spirit is in Heaven; its seat is in the chamber.

sentences.zh: 子子孫孫，孝思無斁。

translations.literal: Sons and sons' sons — filial thought without end.
translations.idiomatic: Sons and sons' sons — filial thought without end.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，更定其初獻合奏，餘並同。

translations.literal: Year 21: the first offering was revised to combined performance; the rest remained the same.
translations.idiomatic: Year 21: the first offering was revised to combined performance; the rest remained the same.

sentences.zh: 思皇先祖，耀靈於天。

translations.literal: Thinking of the august forebears — their spirit shines in Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Thinking of the august forebears — their spirit shines in Heaven.

sentences.zh: 源衍慶流，由高逮玄。

translations.literal: The source spreads blessing's flow — from the high reaching to the dark.
translations.idiomatic: The source spreads blessing's flow — from the high reaching to the dark.

sentences.zh: 玄孫受命，追遠其先。

translations.literal: The dark grandson received the mandate — pursuing the distant in their forebears.
translations.idiomatic: The dark grandson received the mandate — pursuing the distant in their forebears.

sentences.zh: 明禋世崇，億萬斯年。

translations.literal: Bright sacrifice honored through the ages — ten thousand myriad years.
translations.idiomatic: Bright sacrifice honored through the ages — ten thousand myriad years.

sentences.zh: 永樂以後，改迎神章「致我眇躬。

translations.literal: After the Yongle reign, the welcoming-spirit stanza line "To my slight person" was changed.
translations.idiomatic: After the Yongle reign, the welcoming-spirit stanza line "To my slight person" was changed.

sentences.zh: 」句爲「助我祖宗」。

translations.literal: The closing line was changed to "Aid my ancestors."
translations.idiomatic: The closing line was changed to "Aid my ancestors."

sentences.zh: 又改終獻章首四句爲「惟前人之功，肇膺天曆。

translations.literal: Also the first four lines of the final-offering stanza were changed to "Only the merit of those before, first receiving Heaven's calendar.
translations.idiomatic: Also the first four lines of the final-offering stanza were changed to "Only the merit of those before, first receiving Heaven's calendar.

sentences.zh: 延及於小子，爰受方國」。

translations.literal: Extending to this young son, who now receives the regions."
translations.idiomatic: Extending to this young son, who now receives the regions."

sentences.zh: 餘並同。

translations.literal: The rest remained the same.
translations.idiomatic: The rest remained the same.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖十五年，孟春九廟特享樂章。

translations.literal: Jiajing year 15: special seasonal hymns for the nine temples in early spring.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing year 15: special seasonal hymns for the nine temples in early spring.

sentences.zh: 太祖廟。

translations.literal: Taizu Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu Temple.

sentences.zh: 迎神，《太和之曲》：於皇於皇兮仰我聖祖，乃武乃文，攘夷正華，爲天下大君。

translations.literal: Welcoming the Spirit, "Supreme Harmony": august, august — we look up to our sage ancestor; martial and cultured, he drove off the barbarians and set China right, becoming the Great Lord of all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Welcoming the Spirit — "Supreme Harmony": august, august — we look up to our sage ancestor; martial and cultured, he drove off the barbarians and set China right, becoming the Great Lord of all under Heaven.

sentences.zh: 比隆於古，越彼放勳。

translations.literal: Matching the ancients in grandeur — surpassing that distant merit.
translations.idiomatic: Matching the ancients in grandeur — surpassing that distant merit.

sentences.zh: 肇造王業，佑啓予子孫。

translations.literal: He first founded the royal enterprise and aided and opened our descendants.
translations.idiomatic: He first founded the royal enterprise and aided and opened our descendants.

sentences.zh: 功德超邁，大室攸尊。

translations.literal: Merit and virtue surpassing all — the Grand Chamber alone is honored.
translations.idiomatic: Merit and virtue surpassing all — the Grand Chamber alone is honored.

sentences.zh: 首稱春祀，誠敬用申。

translations.literal: First called the spring sacrifice — sincerity and reverence are applied.
translations.idiomatic: First called the spring sacrifice — sincerity and reverence are applied.

sentences.zh: 維神格思，萬世如存。

translations.literal: May the spirit come — ten thousand ages as if present.
translations.idiomatic: May the spirit come — ten thousand ages as if present.

sentences.zh: 初獻。

translations.literal: First offering.
translations.idiomatic: First offering.

sentences.zh: 《壽和之曲》：薦帛於篚，潔牲於俎，嘉我黍稷，酌我清酤。

translations.literal: "Longevity and Harmony": silks are presented in the basket, pure victims on the tray, our millet and grain are fine, we pour our clear wine.
translations.idiomatic: "Longevity and Harmony": silks in the basket, pure victims on the tray, our finest grain, and clear wine poured forth.

sentences.zh: 愚孫毖祀，奠獻初舉。

translations.literal: The foolish grandson performs the careful sacrifice; the first offering is first raised.
translations.idiomatic: The foolish grandson performs the careful sacrifice; the first offering is first raised.

sentences.zh: 翼翼精誠，對越我皇祖。

translations.literal: Earnest, earnest in sincerity — facing our august imperial ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Earnest, earnest in sincerity — facing our august imperial ancestor.

sentences.zh: 居然顧歆，永錫純祜。

translations.literal: Clearly He looks down and accepts; forever bestowing pure blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Clearly He looks down and accepts; forever bestowing pure blessing.

sentences.zh: 亞獻，《豫和之曲》：籥舞既薦，八音洋洋，工歌喤喤。

translations.literal: Second offering, "Ease and Harmony": the flute dance is already presented; the eight tones are vast and full; the workers sing in resounding chorus.
translations.idiomatic: Second offering — "Ease and Harmony": the flute dance is already presented; the eight tones are vast and full; the workers sing in resounding chorus.

sentences.zh: 醇醴載羞，齊明其將之。

translations.literal: Rich brew is borne as offering, pure and bright they shall present it.
translations.idiomatic: Rich brew is borne as offering; pure and bright they shall present it.

sentences.zh: 永佑於子孫，歲事其承之。

translations.literal: Forever protect our descendants — yearly rites shall carry them on.
translations.idiomatic: Forever protect our descendants; yearly rites shall carry them on.

sentences.zh: 俾嗣續克承，百世其保之。

translations.literal: May succession be able to continue — a hundred generations shall preserve it.
translations.idiomatic: May succession endure and continue; a hundred generations shall preserve it.

sentences.zh: 終獻，《寧和之曲》：三爵既崇，禮秩有終。

translations.literal: Final offering, "Tranquil Harmony": three goblets already raised high — ritual order has its end.
translations.idiomatic: Final offering — "Tranquil Harmony": three goblets are raised high; ritual order reaches its end.

sentences.zh: 盈溢孚顒，顯相肅雍。

translations.literal: Overflowing, full of trust, radiant assistants solemn and harmonious.
translations.idiomatic: Overflowing with trust, radiant assistants solemn and harmonious.

sentences.zh: 惟皇祖格哉，以繹以融，申錫無窮。

translations.literal: Only the imperial ancestor draws near — by extension, by fusion, bestowing without end.
translations.idiomatic: Only the imperial ancestor draws near — extending, merging, bestowing without end.

sentences.zh: 暨於臣民，萬福攸同。

translations.literal: Reaching ministers and people — ten thousand blessings alike.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching ministers and people alike — ten thousand blessings shared.

sentences.zh: 徹饌，《豫和之曲》：禮畢樂成，神悅人宜。

translations.literal: Removing the feast, "Ease and Harmony": rite complete, music accomplished — spirit pleased, people at ease.
translations.idiomatic: Removing the feast — "Ease and Harmony": rite and music complete; spirit pleased, people at ease.

sentences.zh: 籩豆靜嘉，敬徹不遲。

translations.literal: Trays and vessels calm and fine — reverently withdrawing without delay.
translations.idiomatic: Trays and vessels stand calm and fine; we withdraw reverently without delay.

sentences.zh: 穆穆有容，秩秩有儀。

translations.literal: Solemn is their bearing, orderly their ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn is their bearing; orderly their ritual.

sentences.zh: 益祗以嚴，矧敢斁於斯。

translations.literal: Ever more reverent and strict — how dare we be remiss in this?
translations.idiomatic: Ever more reverent and strict — how dare we be remiss in this?

sentences.zh: 還宮，《安和之曲》：於皇我祖，陟降在天。

translations.literal: Returning to the palace, "Secure Harmony": august is our ancestor, ascending and descending in Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Returning to the palace — "Secure Harmony": august is our ancestor, ascending and descending in Heaven.

sentences.zh: 清廟翼翼，禋祀首虔。
