translations.literal: The clear temple spreads its wings — sacrificial rite foremost in reverence.
translations.idiomatic: The clear temple spreads its wings; sacrificial rite is foremost in reverence.

sentences.zh: 明神既留，寢祏靜淵。

translations.literal: The bright spirit has already remained — spirit tablet quiet in the deep.
translations.idiomatic: The bright spirit has already remained; the spirit tablet rests quiet in the deep.

sentences.zh: 介福綏祿，錫胤綿綿。

translations.literal: Great blessing, peace and emolument — bestowing heirs in endless line.
translations.idiomatic: Great blessing, peace and emolument — bestowing heirs in endless line.

sentences.zh: 以惠我家邦，於萬斯年。

translations.literal: To bless our house and state — for ten thousand years.
translations.idiomatic: To bless our house and state for ten thousand years.

sentences.zh: 成祖廟。

translations.literal: Temple of the Chengzu Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Temple of Emperor Chengzu.

sentences.zh: 迎神，《太和之曲》：於惟文皇，重光是宣。

translations.literal: Welcoming the Spirit, "Supreme Harmony": ah, the Martial Emperor — doubled brilliance is proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: Welcoming the Spirit — "Supreme Harmony": ah, the Martial Emperor — doubled brilliance is proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 克戡內難，轉坤旋乾。

translations.literal: Able to quell internal strife — turning earth, revolving heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Able to quell internal strife — turning earth, revolving heaven.

sentences.zh: 外讋百蠻，威行八埏。

translations.literal: Without awing the hundred barbarians abroad — authority reaching the eight bounds.
translations.idiomatic: Without awing the hundred barbarians abroad — his authority reached the eight bounds.

sentences.zh: 貽典則於子孫，不忘不愆。

translations.literal: Bequeathing canon and model to descendants — never forgetting, never erring.
translations.idiomatic: Bequeathing canon and model to descendants — never forgetting, never erring.

sentences.zh: 聖德神功，格於皇天。

translations.literal: Sage virtue, divine merit — drawing near to august Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Sage virtue and divine merit draw near to august Heaven.

sentences.zh: 作廟奕奕，百世不遷。

translations.literal: The temple built spreads wide — a hundred generations without removal.
translations.idiomatic: The temple built spreads wide — a hundred generations without removal.

sentences.zh: 祀事孔明，億萬斯年。

translations.literal: Sacrificial affairs bright and clear — billions of years.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrificial affairs bright and clear — for billions of years.

sentences.zh: 初獻、亞獻、終獻、徹饌、還宮，俱與太祖廟同。

translations.literal: First offering, second offering, final offering, removing the feast, and returning to the palace — all the same as the Taizu temple.
translations.idiomatic: First offering, second offering, final offering, removing the feast, and returning to the palace are all the same as at the Taizu temple.

sentences.zh: 仁宗廟。

translations.literal: Temple of the Renzong Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Temple of Emperor Renzong.

sentences.zh: 迎神，《太和之曲》：明明我祖，盛德天成。

translations.literal: Welcoming the Spirit, "Supreme Harmony": bright and bright is our ancestor — sage virtue Heaven-formed.
translations.idiomatic: Welcoming the Spirit — "Supreme Harmony": bright and bright is our ancestor — sage virtue Heaven-formed.

sentences.zh: 至治訏謨，遹駿有聲。

translations.literal: Utmost governance, far-reaching plans — swiftly famed his sound.
translations.idiomatic: Utmost governance and far-reaching plans — swiftly his fame resounded.

sentences.zh: 專奠致享，惟古經是程。

translations.literal: Dedicated offerings to present enjoyment — only the ancient canon is the measure.
translations.idiomatic: Dedicated offerings to present enjoyment — only the ancient canon is the measure.

sentences.zh: 春祀有嚴，以迓聖靈。

translations.literal: Spring sacrifice has its sternness — to welcome the sage spirit.
translations.idiomatic: Spring sacrifice has its sternness — to welcome the sage spirit.

sentences.zh: 惟陟降在庭，以賚我思成。

translations.literal: Only ascending and descending in the court — to bestow our thoughts fulfilled.
translations.idiomatic: Only ascending and descending in the court — to bestow our thoughts fulfilled.

sentences.zh: 初獻，《壽和之曲》：幣牲在陳，金石在懸。

translations.literal: First offering, "Longevity and Harmony": silks and victims are set forth, metal and stone hang suspended.
translations.idiomatic: First offering — "Longevity and Harmony": silks and victims are set forth; metal and stone hang suspended.

sentences.zh: 清酒方獻，百執事有虔。

translations.literal: Clear wine is just offered — the hundred officers reverent.
translations.idiomatic: Clear wine is just offered — the hundred officers reverent.

sentences.zh: 明神洋洋，降歆自天。

translations.literal: The bright spirit vast and far — descending to enjoy from Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The bright spirit vast and far — descending to enjoy from Heaven.

sentences.zh: 俾我孝孫，德音孔宣。

translations.literal: May our filial grandson — virtuous fame greatly proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: May our filial grandson — virtuous fame greatly proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 亞獻，《豫和之曲》：中誠方殷，明神如存。

translations.literal: Second offering, "Ease and Harmony": central sincerity just full — the bright spirit as if present.
translations.idiomatic: Second offering — "Ease and Harmony": central sincerity just full — the bright spirit as if present.

sentences.zh: 醴齊孔醇，再舉罍尊。

translations.literal: Sacrificial brew utterly pure — again raising the urn goblet.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrificial brew utterly pure — again raising the urn goblet.

sentences.zh: 福祿穰穰，攸介攸臻。

translations.literal: Blessing and emolument abundant — both near and come.
translations.idiomatic: Blessing and emolument abundant — both near and come.

sentences.zh: 追遠報酬，罔極之恩。

translations.literal: Pursuing the distant, repaying obligation — boundless grace.
translations.idiomatic: Pursuing the distant, repaying obligation — boundless grace.

sentences.zh: 終獻，《寧和之曲》：樂比聲歌，佾舞婆娑。

translations.literal: Final offering, "Tranquil Harmony": music matches voice-song — line-dance whirling.
translations.idiomatic: Final offering — "Tranquil Harmony": music matches voice-song; line-dance whirls.

sentences.zh: 稱彼玉爵，酒旨且多。

translations.literal: Praising that jade goblet — wine sweet and plentiful.
translations.idiomatic: Praising that jade goblet — wine sweet and plentiful.

sentences.zh: 獻享維終，神聽以和。

translations.literal: Offering and enjoyment at their end — the spirit listens in harmony.
translations.idiomatic: Offering and enjoyment at their end — the spirit listens in harmony.

sentences.zh: 徹饌，《雍和之曲》：牷牲在俎，稷黍在簠。

translations.literal: Removing the feast, "Harmonious Peace": victims on the tray, millet and broomcorn in the grain vessels.
translations.idiomatic: Removing the feast — "Harmonious Peace": victims on the tray; millet and broomcorn in the grain vessels.

sentences.zh: 孝享多儀，格我皇祖。

translations.literal: Filial enjoyment with many rites — drawing near our imperial ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Filial enjoyment with many rites — drawing near our imperial ancestor.

sentences.zh: 稱歌進徹，髦士ＡＳＡＳ。

translations.literal: Praising song as we withdraw — eminent officers reverent and earnest.
translations.idiomatic: Praising song as we withdraw — eminent officers reverent and earnest.

sentences.zh: 孝孫受福，以敷錫於下土。

translations.literal: The filial grandson receives blessing — to spread bestowal on the lower earth.
translations.idiomatic: The filial grandson receives blessing — to spread bestowal on the lower earth.

sentences.zh: 還宮，《安和之曲》：犆享孔明，物備禮成。

translations.literal: Returning to the palace, "Secure Harmony": pure offering bright and clear — objects prepared, rite accomplished.
translations.idiomatic: Returning to the palace — "Secure Harmony": pure offering bright and clear; objects prepared, rite accomplished.

sentences.zh: 於昭在天，以莫不聽。

translations.literal: How bright in Heaven — none does not listen.
translations.idiomatic: How bright in Heaven — none does not listen.

sentences.zh: 神明即安，維華寢是憑。

translations.literal: Spirit and brightness already at peace — relying on the splendid sleeping chamber.
translations.idiomatic: Spirit and brightness already at peace — relying on the splendid sleeping chamber.

sentences.zh: 肇祀迄今，百世祗承。

translations.literal: Since sacrifice began until now — a hundred generations reverently inherit.
translations.idiomatic: Since sacrifice began until now — a hundred generations reverently inherit.

sentences.zh: 宣廟、英廟、憲廟俱與仁廟同。

translations.literal: The Xuan, Ying, and Xian temples are all the same as the Ren temple.
translations.idiomatic: The Xuan, Ying, and Xian temples are all the same as the Ren temple.

sentences.zh: 孝廟。

translations.literal: Temple of the Xiaozong Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Temple of Emperor Xiaozong.

sentences.zh: 迎神，《太和之曲》：列祖垂統，景運重熙。

translations.literal: Welcoming the Spirit, "Supreme Harmony": successive ancestors hand down the line — splendid fortune renewed and bright.
translations.idiomatic: Welcoming the Spirit — "Supreme Harmony": successive ancestors hand down the line — splendid fortune renewed and bright.

sentences.zh: 於惟孝皇，敬德允持。

translations.literal: Ah, the Filial Emperor — reverent virtue truly upheld.
translations.idiomatic: Ah, the Filial Emperor — reverent virtue truly upheld.

sentences.zh: 用光於大烈，化被烝黎。

translations.literal: Employed to shine upon great merit — transforming spread to the multitude.
translations.idiomatic: Employed to shine upon great merit — transforming spread to the multitude.

sentences.zh: 專廟以享，經禮攸宜。

translations.literal: Dedicated temple to enjoy — canonical rite is fitting.
translations.idiomatic: Dedicated temple to enjoy — canonical rite is fitting.

sentences.zh: 俎豆式陳，庶幾來思。

translations.literal: Trays and vessels formally set forth — we hope You will come in thought.
translations.idiomatic: Trays and vessels formally set forth — we hope You will come in thought.

sentences.zh: 初獻，《壽和之曲》：粢盛孔蠲，腯肥牲牷。

translations.literal: First offering, "Longevity and Harmony": offerings utterly pure — fat and plump sacrificial victims.
translations.idiomatic: First offering — "Longevity and Harmony": offerings utterly pure — fat and plump sacrificial victims.

sentences.zh: 考鼓雰雰，萬舞躚躚。

translations.literal: Examining drums booming — myriad dancers lightly tripping.
translations.idiomatic: Examining drums booming — myriad dancers lightly tripping.

sentences.zh: 清醑初酌，對越在天。

translations.literal: Clear brew first poured — facing and answering in Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Clear brew first poured — facing and answering in Heaven.

sentences.zh: 明神居歆，式昭厥虔。

translations.literal: The bright spirit dwells and enjoys — thereby manifesting that reverence.
translations.idiomatic: The bright spirit dwells and enjoys — thereby manifesting that reverence.

sentences.zh: 亞獻，《豫和之曲》：祀事孔勤，精意未分。

translations.literal: Second offering, "Ease and Harmony": sacrificial affairs utterly diligent — refined intent not yet divided.
translations.idiomatic: Second offering — "Ease and Harmony": sacrificial affairs utterly diligent — refined intent not yet divided.

sentences.zh: 樂感鳳儀，禮虔駿奔。

translations.literal: Music moves phoenix bearing — rite reverent, earnest running.
translations.idiomatic: Music moves phoenix bearing — rite reverent, earnest running.

sentences.zh: 醞齊挹清，載奠瑤尊。

translations.literal: Brew seasoned, clear poured — bearing and setting the jade goblet.
translations.idiomatic: Brew seasoned, clear poured — bearing and setting the jade goblet.

sentences.zh: 神其格思，福祿來臻。

translations.literal: May the spirit draw near in thought — blessing and emolument come.
translations.idiomatic: May the spirit draw near in thought — blessing and emolument come.

sentences.zh: 終獻，《寧和之曲》：樂舞既成，獻享維終。

translations.literal: Final offering, "Tranquil Harmony": music and dance already accomplished — offering and enjoyment at their end.
translations.idiomatic: Final offering — "Tranquil Harmony": music and dance accomplished; offering and enjoyment at their end.

sentences.zh: 明明對越，彌篤其恭。

translations.literal: Bright and bright facing and answering — ever more earnest the reverence.
translations.idiomatic: Bright and bright facing and answering — ever more earnest the reverence.

sentences.zh: 篤恭維何？

translations.literal: Earnest reverence — for what?
translations.idiomatic: Earnest reverence — for what?

sentences.zh: 明德是崇。

translations.literal: Bright virtue is honored.
translations.idiomatic: Bright virtue is honored.

sentences.zh: 神之聽之，萬福來同。

translations.literal: Spirit, hear this — ten thousand blessings alike come.
translations.idiomatic: Spirit, hear this — ten thousand blessings alike come.

sentences.zh: 徹饌，《雍和之曲》：牲牢醴陳，我享我將，黍稷蘋藻，潔白馨香。

translations.literal: Removing the feast, "Harmonious Peace": victims and wine set forth — we enjoy, we present; millet, broomcorn, duckweed and water plants — pure white, fragrant and fine.
translations.idiomatic: Removing the feast — "Harmonious Peace": victims and wine set forth — we enjoy, we present; millet, broomcorn, duckweed and water plants pure white, fragrant and fine.

sentences.zh: 徹以告成，降禧穰穰。

translations.literal: Withdrawal announces completion — descending blessing abundant.
translations.idiomatic: Withdrawal announces completion — descending blessing abundant.

sentences.zh: 神錫無疆，祐我萬方。

translations.literal: Spirit bestows without bound — protecting our ten thousand regions.
translations.idiomatic: Spirit bestows without bound — protecting our ten thousand regions.

sentences.zh: 還宮，《安和之曲》：禮享既洽，神御聿興。

translations.literal: Returning to the palace, "Secure Harmony": ritual enjoyment already harmonious — spirit carriage forthwith rises.
translations.idiomatic: Returning to the palace — "Secure Harmony": ritual enjoyment harmonious; spirit carriage forthwith rises.

sentences.zh: 廟寢煌煌，以憑以寧。

translations.literal: Temple sleeping chamber blazing bright — to rely upon, to rest in peace.
translations.idiomatic: Temple sleeping chamber blazing bright — to rely upon, to rest in peace.

sentences.zh: 維神匪遐，上下在庭。

translations.literal: Only the spirit is not distant — above and below in the court.
translations.idiomatic: Only the spirit is not distant — above and below in the court.

sentences.zh: 於寢孔安，永底我烝民之生。

translations.literal: In the sleeping chamber utterly at peace — forever securing the lives of our multitude.
translations.idiomatic: In the sleeping chamber utterly at peace — forever securing the lives of our multitude.

sentences.zh: 武廟。

translations.literal: Temple of the Wuzong Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Temple of Emperor Wuzong.

sentences.zh: 迎神，《太和之曲》：列祖垂統，景運重熙。

translations.literal: Welcoming the Spirit, "Supreme Harmony": successive ancestors hand down the line — splendid fortune renewed and bright.
translations.idiomatic: Welcoming the Spirit — "Supreme Harmony": successive ancestors hand down the line — splendid fortune renewed and bright.

sentences.zh: 於惟武皇，昭德敕威。

translations.literal: Ah, the Martial Emperor — manifest virtue commands awe.
translations.idiomatic: Ah, the Martial Emperor — manifest virtue commands awe.

sentences.zh: 用剪除奸ＡＴ，大業弗隳。

translations.literal: Used to cut down and remove traitors — great enterprise not overthrown.
translations.idiomatic: Used to cut down and remove traitors — great enterprise not overthrown.

sentences.zh: 專廟以享，經禮攸宜。

translations.literal: Dedicated temple to enjoy — canonical rite is fitting.
translations.idiomatic: Dedicated temple to enjoy — canonical rite is fitting.

sentences.zh: 俎豆式陳，庶幾來思。

translations.literal: Trays and vessels formally set forth — we hope You will come in thought.
translations.idiomatic: Trays and vessels formally set forth — we hope You will come in thought.

sentences.zh: 初獻、亞獻、終獻及徹饌、還宮，俱與孝廟同。

translations.literal: First offering, second offering, final offering, removing the feast, and returning to the palace — all the same as the Xiao temple.
translations.idiomatic: First offering, second offering, final offering, removing the feast, and returning to the palace are all the same as at the Xiao temple.

sentences.zh: 睿廟。

translations.literal: Temple of the Ruizong Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Temple of Emperor Ruizong.

sentences.zh: 迎神，《太和之曲》：於穆神皇，秉德凝道。

translations.literal: Welcoming the Spirit, "Supreme Harmony": how solemn the Divine Emperor — holding virtue, condensing the Way.
translations.idiomatic: Welcoming the Spirit — "Supreme Harmony": how solemn the Divine Emperor — holding virtue, condensing the Way.

sentences.zh: 仁厚積累，配於穹昊。

translations.literal: Benevolence and thickness accumulated — paired with the vast vault.
translations.idiomatic: Benevolence and thickness accumulated — paired with the vast vault.

sentences.zh: 流慶顯休，萃於眇躬。

translations.literal: Flowing celebration, manifest blessing — gathered upon my slight person.
translations.idiomatic: Flowing celebration, manifest blessing — gathered upon my slight person.

sentences.zh: 施於無窮，以似以續，以光紹我皇宗。

translations.literal: Bestowed without end — by likeness, by continuation — to gloriously continue our imperial clan.
translations.idiomatic: Bestowed without end — by likeness, by continuation — to gloriously continue our imperial clan.

sentences.zh: 惟茲氣始，俎豆是供。

translations.literal: Only at this season's beginning — trays and vessels are offered.
translations.idiomatic: Only at this season's beginning — trays and vessels are offered.

sentences.zh: 循厥典禮，式敬式崇。

translations.literal: Following that canonical rite — reverent, honored.
translations.idiomatic: Following that canonical rite — reverent, honored.

sentences.zh: 神其至止，以鑑愚衷。

translations.literal: May the spirit arrive and halt — to mirror our foolish hearts.
translations.idiomatic: May the spirit arrive and halt — to mirror our foolish hearts.

sentences.zh: 初獻，《壽和之曲》：制帛牲牢，庶羞芬。

translations.literal: First offering, "Longevity and Harmony": fashioned silks, victims in pens — various delicacies fragrant and fine.
translations.idiomatic: First offering — "Longevity and Harmony": fashioned silks, victims in pens — various delicacies fragrant and fine.

sentences.zh: 玉戚硃幹，協於韶簫。

translations.literal: Jade battle-axes and vermilion shields — harmonizing with Shao music and flutes.
translations.idiomatic: Jade battle-axes and vermilion shields — harmonizing with Shao music and flutes.

sentences.zh: 清醑在筵，中情纏綿。

translations.literal: Clear brew on the mat — central feeling tangled and deep.
translations.idiomatic: Clear brew on the mat — central feeling tangled and deep.

sentences.zh: 神之格思，儀形僾然。

translations.literal: Spirit draws near in thought — bearing and form seemingly present.
translations.idiomatic: Spirit draws near in thought — bearing and form seemingly present.

sentences.zh: 亞獻，《豫和之曲》：瑤爵再陳，侑以工歌。

translations.literal: Second offering, "Ease and Harmony": jade goblets set forth again — assisted by craftsmen's song.
translations.idiomatic: Second offering — "Ease and Harmony": jade goblets set forth again — assisted by craftsmen's song.

sentences.zh: 籥舞蹌蹌，八音諧和。

translations.literal: Flute-dance stately — eight tones in harmony.
translations.idiomatic: Flute-dance stately — eight tones in harmony.

sentences.zh: 孝思肫肫，感格聖靈。

translations.literal: Filial thought earnest and deep — moving and drawing the sage spirit.
translations.idiomatic: Filial thought earnest and deep — moving and drawing the sage spirit.

sentences.zh: 致愨則存，如聞其聲。

translations.literal: Utmost sincerity then remains — as if hearing the sound.
translations.idiomatic: Utmost sincerity then remains — as if hearing the sound.

sentences.zh: 終獻，《寧和之曲》：儀式弗逾，奠爵維三。

translations.literal: Final offering, "Tranquil Harmony": ritual form not exceeded — setting goblets is thrice.
translations.idiomatic: Final offering — "Tranquil Harmony": ritual form not exceeded; setting goblets is thrice.

sentences.zh: 樂舞雍容，以雅以南。

translations.literal: Music and dance dignified — with Ya and with Nan.
translations.idiomatic: Music and dance dignified — with Ya and with Nan.

sentences.zh: 仰仁源德澤，嶽崇海淵。

translations.literal: Looking up to the source of benevolence and virtue's grace — mountains lofty, seas deep.
translations.idiomatic: Looking up to the source of benevolence and virtue's grace — mountains lofty, seas deep.

sentences.zh: 願啓我子孫，緝熙光明，維兩儀是參。

translations.literal: We wish to open our descendants — bright splendor gathered, joining the two principles.
translations.idiomatic: We wish to open our descendants — bright splendor gathered, joining the two principles.

sentences.zh: 徹饌，《雍和之曲》：嘉饌甘只，亦既歆只。

translations.literal: Removing the feast, "Harmonious Peace": fine delicacies sweet indeed — already enjoyed indeed.
translations.idiomatic: Removing the feast — "Harmonious Peace": fine delicacies sweet indeed — already enjoyed indeed.

sentences.zh: 登歌迅徹，敬終惟始。

translations.literal: Ascending song swiftly withdrawn — reverent end is only beginning.
translations.idiomatic: Ascending song swiftly withdrawn — reverent end is only beginning.

sentences.zh: 維神孔昭，賚永成於孝矣。

translations.literal: Only the spirit greatly bright — bestowing eternal completion in filial piety.
translations.idiomatic: Only the spirit greatly bright — bestowing eternal completion in filial piety.

sentences.zh: 還宮，《安和之曲》：幽顯莫測，神之無方。

translations.literal: Returning to the palace, "Secure Harmony": hidden and manifest cannot be measured — the spirit has no fixed direction.
translations.idiomatic: Returning to the palace — "Secure Harmony": hidden and manifest cannot be measured — the spirit has no fixed direction.

sentences.zh: 祀事既成，神返諸帝鄉。

translations.literal: Sacrificial affairs already accomplished — spirit returns to the Emperor's realm.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrificial affairs accomplished — spirit returns to the Emperor's realm.

sentences.zh: 申發休祥，俾胤嗣蕃昌。

translations.literal: Extending and sending forth auspicious blessing — may heirs and succession flourish.
translations.idiomatic: Extending and sending forth auspicious blessing — may heirs and succession flourish.

sentences.zh: 宜君兮宜王，歷世無疆。

translations.literal: Fit for lord, fit for king — age after age without bound.
translations.idiomatic: Fit for lord, fit for king — age after age without bound.

sentences.zh: ○九廟時祫樂章

translations.literal: Music for the seasonal di of the Nine Temples.
translations.idiomatic: Hymns for the seasonal di of the Nine Temples.

sentences.zh: 孟夏。

translations.literal: Early summer.
translations.idiomatic: Early summer.

sentences.zh: 迎神，《太和之曲》：序屆夏首兮風氣薰，禮嚴時祫兮拏擊鐘{卉鼓}。

translations.literal: Welcoming the Spirit, "Supreme Harmony": season reaches summer's beginning — vapor fragrant; rite stern at seasonal di — striking bells and drums.
translations.idiomatic: Welcoming the Spirit — "Supreme Harmony": season reaches summer's beginning, vapor fragrant; rite stern at seasonal di — striking bells and drums.

sentences.zh: 迎羣主來合享交欣，於皇列聖正南面，以申崇報皇勳。

translations.literal: Welcoming the host lords to join in shared enjoyment and mutual joy — august successive sages face south, to extend lofty repayment of imperial merit.
translations.idiomatic: Welcoming the host lords to join in shared enjoyment; august successive sages face south to extend lofty repayment of imperial merit.

sentences.zh: 初獻，《壽和之曲》：瞻曙色方昕，仰列聖在上，奠金觥而捧幣紋。

translations.literal: First offering, "Longevity and Harmony": gazing at dawn's color just brightening — looking up, successive sages above, setting golden goblet and bearing patterned silks.
translations.idiomatic: First offering — "Longevity and Harmony": gazing at dawn just brightening, successive sages above; we set golden goblet and bear patterned silks.

sentences.zh: 小孫執盈兮敢不懼慇。

translations.literal: Young grandson holding full — how dare he not be earnest and fearful.
translations.idiomatic: Young grandson holding full — how dare he not be earnest and fearful.

sentences.zh: 亞獻，《豫和之曲》：思皇祖，仰聖神。

translations.literal: Second offering, "Ease and Harmony": thinking of the august ancestor — looking up to the sage spirit.
translations.idiomatic: Second offering — "Ease and Harmony": thinking of the august ancestor — looking up to the sage spirit.

sentences.zh: 來列主，會太宸。

translations.literal: Coming, host lords — meeting the Great Azure.
translations.idiomatic: Coming, host lords — meeting the Great Azure.

sentences.zh: 時祫修，循古倫。

translations.literal: Seasonal di restored — following ancient order.
translations.idiomatic: Seasonal di restored — following ancient order.

sentences.zh: 惟聖鑑歆，愚孫忱恂。

translations.literal: Only the sage mirrors and enjoys — foolish grandson sincere and earnest.
translations.idiomatic: Only the sage mirrors and enjoys — foolish grandson sincere and earnest.

sentences.zh: 終獻，《寧和之曲》：齊醴清兮麥熟新，籩豆潔兮孝念申。

translations.literal: Final offering, "Tranquil Harmony": sacrificial brew clear — wheat ripe and new; trays and vessels pure — filial thought expressed.
translations.idiomatic: Final offering — "Tranquil Harmony": sacrificial brew clear, wheat ripe and new; trays and vessels pure, filial thought expressed.

sentences.zh: 仰祖功兮宗德，願降祐兮後人。

translations.literal: Looking up to ancestral merit and clan virtue — we wish blessing lowered upon those who follow.
translations.idiomatic: Looking up to ancestral merit and clan virtue — we wish blessing lowered upon those who follow.

sentences.zh: 徹饌，《雍和之曲》：樂終兮禮成，告玉振兮訖金聲。

translations.literal: Removing the feast, "Harmonious Peace": music ended — rite accomplished; announcing jade chime ended — metal sound complete.
translations.idiomatic: Removing the feast — "Harmonious Peace": music ended, rite accomplished; jade chime ended, metal sound complete.

sentences.zh: 徹之弗違，以肅精誠。

translations.literal: Withdrawal without violation — thereby solemnizing sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: Withdrawal without violation — thereby solemnizing sincerity.

sentences.zh: 還宮，《安和之曲》：三獻就兮祖宗鑑享，一誠露兮念維長。

translations.literal: Returning to the palace, "Secure Harmony": three offerings done — ancestors mirror and enjoy; one sincerity revealed — thought runs long.
translations.idiomatic: Returning to the palace — "Secure Harmony": three offerings done, ancestors mirror and enjoy; one sincerity revealed, thought runs long.

sentences.zh: 思弗盡兮思弗忘，深荷德澤之啓佑，小孫惟賴以餘光。

translations.literal: Thought not exhausted — thought not forgotten; deeply bearing virtue's grace and opening protection — young grandson only relies on remaining light.
translations.idiomatic: Thought not exhausted, thought not forgotten; deeply bearing virtue's grace, young grandson only relies on remaining light.

sentences.zh: 神返宮永安，保家國益昌。

translations.literal: Spirit returns to palace in lasting peace — protecting house and state ever more glorious.
translations.idiomatic: Spirit returns to palace in lasting peace — protecting house and state ever more glorious.

sentences.zh: 孟秋。

translations.literal: Early autumn.
translations.idiomatic: Early autumn.

sentences.zh: 迎神：時兮孟秋火西流，感時毖祀兮爽氣回。

translations.literal: Welcoming the Spirit: season is early autumn — fire flows west; feeling the season's careful sacrifice — clear vapor returns.
translations.idiomatic: Welcoming the Spirit: season is early autumn, fire flows west; feeling the season's careful sacrifice, clear vapor returns.

sentences.zh: 喜金風兮飄來，仰祖宗兮永慕哉。

translations.literal: Joyful — golden wind comes drifting; looking up to ancestors — forever longing.
translations.idiomatic: Joyful golden wind comes drifting; looking up to ancestors, forever longing.

sentences.zh: 秋祫是舉兮希鑑歆，小孫恭迓兮捧素裁。

translations.literal: Autumn di is raised — we hope for mirroring and enjoyment; young grandson reverently meets — bearing plain silks.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn di is raised — we hope for mirroring and enjoyment; young grandson reverently meets, bearing plain silks.

sentences.zh: 初獻：皇祖降筵，列聖靈聯。

translations.literal: First offering: imperial ancestor descends to the mat — successive sages' spirits joined.
translations.idiomatic: First offering: imperial ancestor descends to the mat — successive sages' spirits joined.

sentences.zh: 執事恐蹎，樂舞蹁躚。

translations.literal: Officers fear stumbling — music and dance lightly tripping.
translations.idiomatic: Officers fear stumbling — music and dance lightly tripping.

sentences.zh: 小孫捧盈兮敢弗虔。

translations.literal: Young grandson holding full — how dare he not be reverent.
translations.idiomatic: Young grandson holding full — how dare he not be reverent.

sentences.zh: 亞獻：再酌兮玉漿，潔淨兮馨香。

translations.literal: Second offering: pouring again — jade brew; pure clean — fragrant and fine.
translations.idiomatic: Second offering: pouring again jade brew; pure, clean, fragrant and fine.

sentences.zh: 祖宗垂享兮錫胤昌，萬歲兮此禮行。

translations.literal: Ancestors lower enjoyment — bestowing heirs flourishing; ten thousand years — this rite proceeds.
translations.idiomatic: Ancestors lower enjoyment, bestowing flourishing heirs; ten thousand years this rite proceeds.

sentences.zh: 終獻：進酒三觥，歌舞雍韺，鐘鼓轟錚。

translations.literal: Final offering: advancing wine three goblets — song and dance harmonious and resonant, bells and drums booming clear.
translations.idiomatic: Final offering: advancing wine in three goblets; song and dance harmonious, bells and drums booming clear.

sentences.zh: 皇祖列聖，永享愚誠。

translations.literal: Imperial ancestor and successive sages — forever enjoying our foolish sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial ancestor and successive sages — forever enjoying our foolish sincerity.

sentences.zh: 徹饌：秋嘗是舉，稌黍豐農。

translations.literal: Removing the feast: autumn offering is raised — glutinous millet and grain abundant in farming.
translations.idiomatic: Removing the feast: autumn offering raised — glutinous millet and grain abundant in farming.

sentences.zh: 三獻既周，聖靈顯容。

translations.literal: Three offerings already complete — sage spirits manifest their bearing.
translations.idiomatic: Three offerings complete — sage spirits manifest their bearing.

sentences.zh: 小孫時思恩德兮惟忡。

translations.literal: Young grandson ever thinking of grace and virtue — only anxious.
translations.idiomatic: Young grandson ever thinking of grace and virtue — only anxious.

sentences.zh: 還宮：仰皇祖兮聖神功，祀典陳兮報莫窮。

translations.literal: Returning to the palace: looking up to imperial ancestor — sage spirit and divine merit; sacrificial canon set forth — repayment without end.
translations.idiomatic: Returning to the palace: looking up to imperial ancestor's sage spirit and divine merit; sacrificial canon set forth, repayment without end.

sentences.zh: 嘗祫告竣，鸞馭旋宮。

translations.literal: Offering di announced complete — luan carriage wheels back to palace.
translations.idiomatic: Offering di announced complete — luan carriage wheels back to palace.

sentences.zh: 皇靈在天主在室，萬祀陟降何有終。

translations.literal: Imperial spirit in Heaven, host in chamber — myriad sacrifices ascending and descending — how could there be an end?
translations.idiomatic: Imperial spirit in Heaven, host in chamber — myriad sacrifices ascending and descending without end.

sentences.zh: 孟冬。

translations.literal: Early winter.
translations.idiomatic: Early winter.

sentences.zh: 迎神：時兮孟冬凜以悽，感時毖祀兮氣潛回。

translations.literal: Welcoming the Spirit: season is early winter — chill and bleak; feeling the season's careful sacrifice — vapor secretly returns.
translations.idiomatic: Welcoming the Spirit: season is early winter, chill and bleak; feeling the season's careful sacrifice, vapor secretly returns.

sentences.zh: 溯朔風兮北來，仰祖宗兮永慕哉。

translations.literal: Tracing north wind — coming from the north; looking up to ancestors — forever longing.
translations.idiomatic: Tracing north wind coming from the north; looking up to ancestors, forever longing.

sentences.zh: 冬祫是舉兮希鑑歆，小孫恭迓兮捧素裁。

translations.literal: Winter di is raised — we hope for mirroring and enjoyment; young grandson reverently meets — bearing plain silks.
translations.idiomatic: Winter di is raised — we hope for mirroring and enjoyment; young grandson reverently meets, bearing plain silks.

sentences.zh: 初、亞、終獻，俱同孟秋。

translations.literal: First, second, and final offerings — all the same as early autumn.
translations.idiomatic: First, second, and final offerings are all the same as early autumn.

sentences.zh: 撤饌：冬烝是舉，俎豆維豐。

translations.literal: Removing the feast: winter offering is raised — trays and vessels abundantly full.
translations.idiomatic: Removing the feast: winter offering raised — trays and vessels abundantly full.

sentences.zh: 三獻既周，聖靈顯容。

translations.literal: Three offerings already complete — sage spirits manifest their bearing.
translations.idiomatic: Three offerings complete — sage spirits manifest their bearing.

sentences.zh: 小孫時思，恩德兮惟忡。

translations.literal: Young grandson ever thinking of grace and virtue — only anxious.
translations.idiomatic: Young grandson ever thinking of grace and virtue — only anxious.

sentences.zh: 還宮。

translations.literal: Returning to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: Returning to the palace.

sentences.zh: 同孟秋，惟改「嘗祫。

translations.literal: Same as early autumn — only the phrase is changed from "autumn offering di."
translations.idiomatic: Same as early autumn, except the phrase is changed from "autumn offering di."

sentences.zh: 」爲「烝祫。」

translations.literal: It was changed to "winter offering di."
translations.idiomatic: It was changed to "winter offering di."

sentences.zh: 大祫樂章。

translations.literal: Music for the great di.
translations.idiomatic: Hymns for the great di.

sentences.zh: 迎神：仰慶源兮大發祥，惟世德兮深長。

translations.literal: Welcoming the Spirit: looking up to the source of celebration — great auspiciousness sent forth; only world-virtue — deep and long.
translations.idiomatic: Welcoming the Spirit: looking up to celebration's source, great auspiciousness sent forth; only world-virtue deep and long.

sentences.zh: 時惟歲殘，大祫洪張。

translations.literal: Season is year's end — great di broadly spread.
translations.idiomatic: Season is year's end — great di broadly spread.

sentences.zh: 祖宗聖神，明明皇皇。

translations.literal: Ancestors sage and divine — bright and august.
translations.idiomatic: Ancestors sage and divine — bright and august.

sentences.zh: 遙瞻兮頓首，世德兮何以忘。

translations.literal: Gazing from afar — bowing head to ground; world-virtue — how can it be forgotten?
translations.idiomatic: Gazing from afar, bowing head to ground; world-virtue — how can it be forgotten?

sentences.zh: 初獻：神之格兮慰我思，慰我思兮捧玉卮。

translations.literal: First offering: spirit draws near — comforting my thought; comforting my thought — bearing jade goblet.
translations.idiomatic: First offering: spirit draws near, comforting my thought; comforting my thought, bearing jade goblet.

sentences.zh: 捧來前兮慄慄，仰歆納兮是幸已而。

translations.literal: Bearing it forward — trembling; looking up to enjoy and accept — this is our good fortune indeed.
translations.idiomatic: Bearing it forward, trembling; looking up to enjoy and accept — this is our good fortune indeed.

sentences.zh: 亞獻：再舉瑤漿，樂舞羣張。

translations.literal: Second offering: raising again jade brew — music and dance spread in ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Second offering: raising again jade brew, music and dance spread in ranks.

sentences.zh: 小孫在位，陪助賢良。

translations.literal: Young grandson in position — assisting worthy men.
translations.idiomatic: Young grandson in position — assisting worthy men.

sentences.zh: 百工羅從，大禮肅將。

translations.literal: Hundred craftsmen arrayed in attendance — great rite solemnly conducted.
translations.idiomatic: Hundred craftsmen arrayed in attendance — great rite solemnly conducted.

sentences.zh: 惟我祖宗，顯錫恩光。

translations.literal: Only our ancestors — manifestly bestowing grace-light.
translations.idiomatic: Only our ancestors — manifestly bestowing grace-light.

sentences.zh: 終獻：思祖功兮深長，景宗德兮馨香。

translations.literal: Final offering: thinking of ancestral merit — deep and long; viewing clan virtue — fragrant and fine.
translations.idiomatic: Final offering: thinking of ancestral merit deep and long; viewing clan virtue fragrant and fine.

sentences.zh: 報歲事之既成兮典則先王，惟功德之莫報兮何以量。

translations.literal: Repaying the year's affairs already accomplished — canon and model of former kings; only merit and virtue beyond repayment — how can it be measured?
translations.idiomatic: Repaying year's affairs accomplished — canon of former kings; merit and virtue beyond repayment — how can it be measured?

sentences.zh: 徹饌：三酌既終，一誠感通。

translations.literal: Removing the feast: three pourings already ended — one sincerity moves through.
translations.idiomatic: Removing the feast: three pourings ended — one sincerity moves through.

sentences.zh: 仰聖靈兮居歆，萬礻異是舉兮庶乎酬報之衷。

translations.literal: Looking up to sage spirit dwelling and enjoying — myriad seasons are raised — perhaps repaying our hearts.
translations.idiomatic: Looking up to sage spirit dwelling and enjoying — myriad seasons raised, perhaps repaying our hearts.

sentences.zh: 還宮：顯兮幽兮，神運無跡。

translations.literal: Returning to the palace: manifest and hidden — spirit's movement without trace.
translations.idiomatic: Returning to the palace: manifest and hidden — spirit's movement without trace.

sentences.zh: 神運無跡兮化無方，靈返天兮主返室。

translations.literal: Spirit's movement without trace — transformation without direction; spirit returns to Heaven — host returns to chamber.
translations.idiomatic: Spirit's movement without trace, transformation without direction; spirit returns to Heaven, host returns to chamber.

sentences.zh: 願神功聖德兮啓佑無終，玄孫拜送兮以謝以祈。

translations.literal: We wish divine merit and sage virtue to open protection without end — great-grandson bows in sending off — thereby thanking, thereby praying.
translations.idiomatic: We wish divine merit and sage virtue to open protection without end; great-grandson bows in sending off, thanking and praying.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖十年大禘樂章。

translations.literal: Music for the great di, tenth year of Jiajing.
translations.idiomatic: Hymns for the great di, Jiajing reign year 10.

sentences.zh: 迎神，《元和之曲》：於維皇祖，肇創丕基。

translations.literal: Welcoming the Spirit, "Primordial Harmony": ah, the imperial ancestor — first establishing the great foundation.
translations.idiomatic: Welcoming the Spirit — "Primordial Harmony": ah, the imperial ancestor — first establishing the great foundation.

sentences.zh: 鍾祥有自，曰本先之。

translations.literal: Auspiciousness bell-like has its source — called root and ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Auspiciousness bell-like has its source — called root and ancestor.

sentences.zh: 奄有萬方，作之君師。

translations.literal: Embracing the ten thousand regions — made their lord and teacher.
translations.idiomatic: Embracing the ten thousand regions — made their lord and teacher.

sentences.zh: 追報宜隆，以申孝思。

translations.literal: Pursuing repayment should be lofty — thereby extending filial thought.
translations.idiomatic: Pursuing repayment should be lofty — thereby extending filial thought.

sentences.zh: 瞻望稽首，介我休禧。

translations.literal: Gazing and looking, bowing head to ground — grant me rest and blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Gazing and looking, bowing head to ground — grant me rest and blessing.

sentences.zh: 初獻，《壽和之曲》：木有本兮水有源，人本祖兮物本天。

translations.literal: First offering, "Longevity and Harmony": trees have roots — water has sources; people have ancestors — things have Heaven as root.
translations.idiomatic: First offering — "Longevity and Harmony": trees have roots, water has sources; people have ancestors, things have Heaven as root.

sentences.zh: 思報德兮禮莫先，仰希鑑兮敢弗虔。

translations.literal: Thinking to repay virtue — rite is foremost; looking up hoping for mirroring — how dare we not be reverent.
translations.idiomatic: Thinking to repay virtue, rite is foremost; looking up hoping for mirroring, how dare we not be reverent.

sentences.zh: 亞獻，《仁和之曲》：中觴載升，於此瑤觥。

translations.literal: Second offering, "Humaneness and Harmony": middle goblet borne upward — at this jade cup.
translations.idiomatic: Second offering — "Humaneness and Harmony": middle goblet borne upward at this jade cup.

sentences.zh: 小孫奉前，願歆其誠。

translations.literal: Young grandson bears it forward — wishing to enjoy that sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: Young grandson bears it forward — wishing to enjoy that sincerity.

sentences.zh: 樂舞在列，庶職在庭。

translations.literal: Music and dance ranked in array — various offices in the court.
translations.idiomatic: Music and dance ranked in array — various offices in the court.

sentences.zh: 祖鑑孔昭，錫祐攸亨。

translations.literal: Ancestor mirrors greatly bright — bestowing protection, thereby prosperous.
translations.idiomatic: Ancestor mirrors greatly bright — bestowing protection, thereby prosperous.

sentences.zh: 終獻，《德和之曲》：於維兮先祖，延慶兮深高。

translations.literal: Final offering, "Virtue and Harmony": ah, the ancestors — extended celebration deep and high.
translations.idiomatic: Final offering — "Virtue and Harmony": ah, the ancestors — extended celebration deep and high.

sentences.zh: 追報兮曷能，三進兮香醪。

translations.literal: Pursuing repayment — how can it be done? Three advances — fragrant brew.
translations.idiomatic: Pursuing repayment — how can it be done? Three advances of fragrant brew.

sentences.zh: 徹饌，《太和之曲》：芬兮豆籩，潔兮黍粢。

translations.literal: Removing the feast, "Supreme Harmony": fragrant are trays and baskets — pure are millet offerings.
translations.idiomatic: Removing the feast — "Supreme Harmony": fragrant are trays and baskets; pure are millet offerings.

sentences.zh: 祖垂歆享，徹乎敢遲。

translations.literal: Ancestor lowers enjoyment — withdrawing, how dare we delay.
translations.idiomatic: Ancestor lowers enjoyment — withdrawing, how dare we delay.

sentences.zh: 禮雲告備，以訖陳辭。

translations.literal: Rite says announcement complete — thereby ending the set forth words.
translations.idiomatic: Rite says announcement complete — thereby ending the set forth words.

sentences.zh: 永裕後人，億世丕而。

translations.literal: Forever enriching those who follow — billions of ages grand and glorious.
translations.idiomatic: Forever enriching those who follow — billions of ages grand and glorious.

sentences.zh: 送神，《永和之曲》：禘祀兮具張，佳氣兮鬱昂。

translations.literal: Sending off the Spirit, "Eternal Harmony": di sacrifice fully spread — fine vapor lofty and rising.
translations.idiomatic: Sending off the Spirit — "Eternal Harmony": di sacrifice fully spread, fine vapor lofty and rising.

sentences.zh: 皇靈錫納兮喜將，一誠通兮萬載昌。

translations.literal: Imperial spirit bestows acceptance — joy about to come; one sincerity moves through — ten thousand ages glorious.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial spirit bestows acceptance, joy about to come; one sincerity moves through, ten thousand ages glorious.

sentences.zh: 祈鑑祐兮天下康，仰源仁浩德兮曷以量。

translations.literal: Praying for mirroring and protection — the world secure; looking up to source-benevolence, vast virtue — how can it be measured?
translations.idiomatic: Praying for mirroring and protection, the world secure; looking up to source-benevolence and vast virtue — how can it be measured?

sentences.zh: 小孫頓首兮以望，遙瞻冉冉兮聖靈皇皇。

translations.literal: Young grandson bows head to ground in gazing — gazing from afar, slowly slowly — sage spirit august and bright.
translations.idiomatic: Young grandson bows head to ground in gazing — gazing from afar, slowly, slowly — sage spirit august and bright.

sentences.zh: 洪武七年，御製祀歷代帝王樂章。

translations.literal: Seventh year of Hongwu — imperially composed music for sacrificing to successive dynasties' emperors.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu reign year 7: imperially composed hymns for sacrificing to successive dynasties' emperors.

sentences.zh: 迎神，《雍和之曲》：仰瞻兮聖容，想鑾輿兮景從。

translations.literal: Welcoming the Spirit, "Harmonious Peace": looking up — sage countenance; thinking of imperial carriage — shadow following.
translations.idiomatic: Welcoming the Spirit — "Harmonious Peace": looking up at sage countenance; thinking of imperial carriage, shadow following.

sentences.zh: 降雲衢兮後先，來俯鑑兮微衷。

translations.literal: Descending cloud pathways — first and after; coming to look down and mirror — our slight hearts.
translations.idiomatic: Descending cloud pathways, first and after; coming to look down and mirror our slight hearts.

sentences.zh: 荷聖臨兮蒼生有崇，眷諸帝兮是臨，予頓首兮幸蒙。

translations.literal: Bearing sage presence — the living have honor; cherishing the emperors — they draw near; I bow head to ground — fortunate to receive grace.
translations.idiomatic: Bearing sage presence, the living have honor; cherishing the emperors, they draw near; I bow my head, fortunate to receive grace.

sentences.zh: 奠帛，《保和之曲》：秉微誠兮動聖躬，來列坐兮殿庭。

translations.literal: Offering silks, "Preserving Harmony": bearing slight sincerity moves the sacred person; coming to take rank seated in the palace hall.
translations.idiomatic: Offering silks — "Preserving Harmony": with humble sincerity we move the sacred presence; they come to take their seats in the palace hall.

sentences.zh: 予今願兮效勤，奉禮帛兮列酒尊。

translations.literal: I now wish to render diligence; bearing ritual silks, arraying wine vessels.
translations.idiomatic: Today I wish to serve with diligence, bearing ritual silks and setting wine vessels in row.

sentences.zh: 鑑予情兮忻享，方旋駕兮雲程。

translations.literal: Mirror my feeling in joyful acceptance; just wheeling the carriage on the cloud path.
translations.idiomatic: Look upon our hearts in joyful acceptance; the carriage wheels homeward on the cloud road.

sentences.zh: 初獻，《保和之曲》：酒行兮爵盈，喜氣兮雍雍。

translations.literal: First offering, "Preserving Harmony": wine proceeds — goblets brim; joy fills the air, harmonious and calm.
translations.idiomatic: First offering — "Preserving Harmony": wine flows and goblets brim; joy fills the hall, harmonious and calm.

sentences.zh: 重荷蒙兮載瞻載崇，羣臣忻兮躍從，願睹穆穆兮聖容。

translations.literal: Heavy grace received — gazing up in reverence; ministers rejoice, leaping to follow; we yearn to see the solemn sacred countenance.
translations.idiomatic: Heavy grace is upon us and we gaze up in reverence; ministers rejoice and leap to follow, yearning to behold the solemn sacred countenance.

sentences.zh: 亞獻，《中和之曲》：酒斟兮禮明，諸帝熙和兮悅情。

translations.literal: Second offering, "Moderation and Harmony": wine poured — the rite is clear; all the emperors harmonious and pleased in feeling.
translations.idiomatic: Second offering — "Moderation and Harmony": wine is poured and the rite stands clear; all the emperors are harmonious, their hearts pleased.

sentences.zh: 百職奔走兮滿庭，陳籩豆兮數重，亞獻兮願成。

translations.literal: A hundred offices hurry — the court is full; spreading trays and vessels in many layers; second offering — may it succeed.
translations.idiomatic: Every office hurries and the court is full; trays and vessels are set in many layers — may the second offering succeed.

sentences.zh: 終獻，《肅和之曲》：獻酒兮至終，早整雲鸞兮將旋宮。

translations.literal: Final offering, "Reverent Harmony": offering wine to the end; early arranging cloud luan — about to wheel back to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: Final offering — "Reverent Harmony": wine is offered to the end; the cloud luan is readied early to return to the palace.

sentences.zh: 予心眷戀兮神聖，欲攀留兮無從。

translations.literal: My heart is attached and longing for the sacred; wishing to climb and hold back — no way to do so.
translations.idiomatic: My heart clings to the sacred presence; I would hold You back, yet cannot.

sentences.zh: 躡雲衢兮緩行，得遙瞻兮達九重。

translations.literal: Treading the cloud thoroughfare — moving slowly; able to gaze from afar — reaching the ninefold palace.
translations.idiomatic: You tread the cloud road and move slowly on; we gaze from afar as You reach the ninefold palace.

sentences.zh: 徹饌，《凝和之曲》：納餚羞兮領陳，烝民樂兮幸生。

translations.literal: Removing the feast, "Concentrated Harmony": receiving delicacies and setting them forth; the multitude rejoice — blessed in life.
translations.idiomatic: Removing the feast — "Concentrated Harmony": delicacies are received and set forth; the people rejoice, blessed in life.

sentences.zh: 將何以兮崇報，惟歲時兮載瞻載迎。

translations.literal: How shall we loftily repay? Only at the seasons — bearing gaze, bearing welcome.
translations.idiomatic: How shall we repay in lofty measure? Only at each season do we gaze and welcome again.

sentences.zh: 送神，《壽和之曲》：幡幢繚繞兮導來蹤，鑾輿冉冉兮歸天宮。

translations.literal: Sending off the Spirit, "Longevity and Harmony": banners and pennants wind about — guiding the coming trace; the imperial carriage slowly, slowly returns to the heavenly palace.
translations.idiomatic: Sending off the Spirit — "Longevity and Harmony": banners and pennants wind about, guiding the path You came; the imperial carriage slowly returns to the heavenly palace.

sentences.zh: 五雲擁兮祥風從，民歌聖佑兮樂年豐。

translations.literal: Five-colored clouds embrace — auspicious wind follows; the people sing of sacred protection — rejoicing in abundant years.
translations.idiomatic: Five-colored clouds embrace You and auspicious wind follows; the people sing of sacred protection and rejoice in abundant years.

sentences.zh: 望燎，《豫和之曲》：神機不測兮造化功，珍羞禮帛兮薦火中。

translations.literal: Gazing at the burning, "Ease and Harmony": spirit design beyond measure — creation's work; delicacies and ritual silks offered into the fire.
translations.idiomatic: Gazing at the burning — "Ease and Harmony": spirit design beyond measure, creation's work; delicacies and ritual silks are offered into the flame.

sentences.zh: 望瘞庭兮稽首，願神鑑兮寸衷。

translations.literal: Gazing at the burial court — bowing head to ground; we wish the spirit would mirror our inch of heart.
translations.idiomatic: We gaze at the burial court and bow our heads; we pray the spirit will look upon our humble hearts.

sentences.zh: 洪武六年定祀先師孔子樂章。

translations.literal: Sixth year of Hongwu — fixed the music for sacrifice to the Former Master Confucius.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu reign year 6: hymns for sacrifice to the Former Master Confucius were established.

sentences.zh: 迎神，《咸和之曲》：大哉宣聖，道德尊崇。

translations.literal: Welcoming the Spirit, "All Harmony": great is the Sagely One who spread the teaching; the Way and virtue are held in highest esteem.
translations.idiomatic: Welcoming the Spirit — "All Harmony": great is the Sagely One who spread the teaching; the Way and virtue are held in highest esteem.

sentences.zh: 維持王化，斯民是宗。

translations.literal: Upholding royal transformation — this people are his followers.
translations.idiomatic: He upholds royal civilization; the people look to him as their guide.

sentences.zh: 典祀有常，精純益隆。

translations.literal: Canonical sacrifice has its constant; refinement and purity ever increase.
translations.idiomatic: Canonical sacrifice has its fixed seasons; refinement and purity grow ever greater.

sentences.zh: 神其來格，於昭聖容。

translations.literal: May the spirit come and draw near; how bright is the sacred countenance.
translations.idiomatic: May the spirit draw near; how bright is the sacred countenance.

sentences.zh: 奠帛，《寧和之曲》：自生民來，誰底其盛？

translations.literal: Offering silks, "Tranquil Harmony": since living people arose — who has reached his greatness?
translations.idiomatic: Offering silks — "Tranquil Harmony": since humankind arose, who has matched his greatness?

sentences.zh: 惟王神明，度越前聖。

translations.literal: Only the King is spirit-bright; surpassing the former sages.
translations.idiomatic: Only the King is spirit-bright, surpassing the sages who came before.

sentences.zh: 粢帛具成，禮容斯稱。

translations.literal: Grain offerings and silks are fully prepared; ritual bearing thereby fitting.
translations.idiomatic: Grain offerings and silks stand ready; ritual bearing is thereby complete.

sentences.zh: 黍稷非馨，惟神之聽。

translations.literal: Millet and panicled millet are not fragrant — only the spirit is heeded.
translations.idiomatic: Millet and panicled millet are not fragrant in themselves; only the spirit is heeded.

sentences.zh: 「惟王」，後改曰：「惟師」。

translations.literal: "Only the King" — later changed to read: "Only the Master."
translations.idiomatic: "Only the King" was later changed to read "Only the Master."

sentences.zh: 初獻，《安和之曲》：太哉聖王，實天生德。

translations.literal: First offering, "Secure Harmony": how great is the sacred king — truly Heaven-born in virtue.
translations.idiomatic: First offering — "Secure Harmony": how great is the sacred king, truly Heaven-born in virtue.

sentences.zh: 作樂以崇，時祀無斁。

translations.literal: Making music to exalt him; seasonal sacrifice without satiety.
translations.idiomatic: We make music to exalt him; seasonal sacrifice never ends.

sentences.zh: 清酤惟馨，嘉牲孔碩。

translations.literal: Clear wine alone is fragrant; fine victims are very large.
translations.idiomatic: Clear wine alone is fragrant; fine victims are ample and grand.

sentences.zh: 薦羞神明，庶幾昭格。

translations.literal: Presenting delicacies to the spirit-bright; we hope perhaps for manifest presence.
translations.idiomatic: We present delicacies to the spirit-bright and hope for manifest presence.

sentences.zh: 亞、終獻，《景和之曲》：百王宗師，生民物軌。

translations.literal: Second and final offerings, "Scenic Harmony": teacher of a hundred kings; for living people, the pattern of things.
translations.idiomatic: Second and final offerings — "Scenic Harmony": teacher of a hundred kings, pattern of life for all the people.

sentences.zh: 瞻之洋洋，神其寧止。

translations.literal: Gazing upon him — vast and ample; may the spirit be tranquil in resting.
translations.idiomatic: We gaze upon him, vast and ample; may the spirit rest in peace.

sentences.zh: 酌彼金罍，惟清且旨。

translations.literal: Pouring from those golden urns — only clear and fine.
translations.idiomatic: We pour from the golden urns, clear and fine.

sentences.zh: 登獻惟三，於戲成禮。

translations.literal: Ascending offerings are only three; alas — the rite is complete.
translations.idiomatic: Three offerings ascend; ah — the rite is complete.

sentences.zh: 徹饌，《咸和之曲》：犧象在前，豆籩在列，以享以薦，既芬既潔。

translations.literal: Removing the feast, "All Harmony": sacrificial oxen and elephants in front; vessels and trays ranked in row; to enjoy and to present — already fragrant, already pure.
translations.idiomatic: Removing the feast — "All Harmony": sacrificial victims stand before, vessels and trays in row; we enjoy and present, fragrant and pure.

sentences.zh: 禮成樂備，人和神悅。

translations.literal: The rite is complete, music prepared; human harmony and spirit joy.
translations.idiomatic: The rite is complete and music prepared; humans are in harmony and the spirit is pleased.

sentences.zh: 祭則受福，率遵無越。

translations.literal: In sacrifice one receives blessing; all follow without transgression.
translations.idiomatic: In sacrifice we receive blessing; all follow without transgression.

sentences.zh: 送神，《咸和之曲》：有嚴學宮，四方來宗。

translations.literal: Sending off the Spirit, "All Harmony": solemn is the academy; from the four quarters they come to honor him.
translations.idiomatic: Sending off the Spirit — "All Harmony": solemn is the academy; from every quarter they come to honor him.

sentences.zh: 恪恭祀事，威儀雍雍。

translations.literal: Earnest and reverent in sacrificial affairs; majesty and bearing harmonious.
translations.idiomatic: Earnest and reverent in sacrifice; majesty and bearing are harmonious.

sentences.zh: 歆格惟馨，神馭旋復。

translations.literal: Acceptance and presence alone are fragrant; the spirit's carriage wheels back.
translations.idiomatic: Acceptance and presence are fragrant alone; the spirit's carriage returns.

sentences.zh: 明禋斯畢，鹹膺百福。

translations.literal: Bright sacrifice is thereby complete; all receive a hundred blessings.
translations.idiomatic: Bright sacrifice is complete; all receive a hundred blessings.

sentences.zh: 洪武二年享先農樂章。

translations.literal: Second year of Hongwu — music for the Feast to the Progenitor of Agriculture.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu reign year 2: hymns for the Feast to the Progenitor of Agriculture.

sentences.zh: 迎神，《永和之曲》：東風啓蟄，地脈奮然。

translations.literal: Welcoming the Spirit, "Eternal Harmony": east wind awakens hibernation; the earth's pulse stirs vigorously.
translations.idiomatic: Welcoming the Spirit — "Eternal Harmony": the east wind awakens hibernation; the earth's pulse stirs vigorously.

sentences.zh: 蒼龍掛角，燁燁天田。

translations.literal: The azure dragon hangs its horn; blazing bright are Heaven's fields.
translations.idiomatic: The azure dragon hangs its horn; Heaven's fields blaze bright.

sentences.zh: 民命惟食，創物有先。

translations.literal: The people's fate is only food; creating things has its forerunner.
translations.idiomatic: The people's fate rests on food; in creating things there is a forerunner.

sentences.zh: 圜鍾既奏，有降斯筵。

translations.literal: The circular bells are already sounded; there is descent to this banquet.
translations.idiomatic: The circular bells have sounded; the spirit descends to this banquet.

sentences.zh: 奠帛，《永和之曲》：帝出乎震，天發農祥。

translations.literal: Offering silks, "Eternal Harmony": the Emperor emerges from Zhen; Heaven sends forth agricultural auspice.
translations.idiomatic: Offering silks — "Eternal Harmony": the Emperor emerges from the east; Heaven sends forth agricultural blessing.

sentences.zh: 神降於筵，藹藹洋洋。

translations.literal: The spirit descends to the banquet — lush and ample.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit descends to the banquet, lush and ample.

sentences.zh: 禮神有帛，其色惟蒼。

translations.literal: Ritual to the spirit has silks; their color is only azure.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual silks for the spirit are azure in color alone.

sentences.zh: 豈伊具物，誠敬之將。

translations.literal: How is it only the objects are complete? Sincerity and reverence bear them forth.
translations.idiomatic: It is not the objects alone that matter; sincerity and reverence bear them forth.

sentences.zh: 進俎，《雍和之曲》：制帛既陳，禮嚴奉牲。

translations.literal: Presenting the sacrifice tray, "Harmonious Peace": patterned silks are already set forth; the rite is stern in presenting victims.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting the sacrifice tray — "Harmonious Peace": patterned silks are set forth; the rite is solemn in presenting victims.

sentences.zh: 載之於俎，祀事孔明。

translations.literal: Bearing them on the tray; sacrificial affairs are very bright.
translations.idiomatic: They are borne on the tray; the sacrifice shines clear.

sentences.zh: 簠簋攸列，黍稷惟馨。

translations.literal: Square and round vessels are ranked in row; millet and panicled millet alone are fragrant.
translations.idiomatic: Square and round vessels stand in row; millet and panicled millet are fragrant.

sentences.zh: 民力普存，先穡之靈。

translations.literal: The people's strength is broadly preserved; spirit of the first harvest.
translations.idiomatic: The people's strength is broadly preserved — spirit of the first harvest.

sentences.zh: 初獻，《壽和之曲》：九穀未分，庶草攸同。

translations.literal: First offering, "Longevity and Harmony": the nine grains are not yet distinguished; the myriad grasses share alike.
translations.idiomatic: First offering — "Longevity and Harmony": the nine grains were undivided; the myriad grasses shared alike.

sentences.zh: 表爲嘉種，實在先農。

translations.literal: Manifest as fine seed; truly in the Progenitor of Agriculture.
translations.idiomatic: Fine seed was made manifest; truly it lies with the Progenitor of Agriculture.

sentences.zh: 黍稌斯豐，酒醴是供。

translations.literal: Millet and broomcorn are thereby abundant; wine and sweet brew are offered.
translations.idiomatic: Millet and broomcorn grow abundant; wine and sweet brew are offered.

sentences.zh: 獻奠之初，以祈感通。

translations.literal: At the beginning of offering and setting forth; to pray for sympathetic communion.
translations.idiomatic: At the first offering we pray for sympathetic communion.

sentences.zh: 配位云：厥初生民，粒食其天。

translations.literal: Paired seat says: when living people first arose, grain was their Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The paired seat recites: when people first arose, grain was their Heaven.

sentences.zh: 開物惟智，邃古奚傳。

translations.literal: Opening things — only wisdom; in remote antiquity, from whom was it handed down?
translations.idiomatic: To open things required wisdom alone; in remote antiquity, from whom was it handed down?

sentences.zh: 思文后稷，農官之先。

translations.literal: Reflect on cultured Hou Ji — forerunner of agricultural officers.
translations.idiomatic: We reflect on cultured Hou Ji, forerunner of agricultural officers.

sentences.zh: 侑神作主，初獻惟蠲。

translations.literal: Assisting the spirit as host; first offering only in purification.
translations.idiomatic: He assists the spirit as host; the first offering is pure alone.

sentences.zh: 亞獻，《壽和之曲》：倬彼甫田，其隰其原。

translations.literal: Second offering, "Longevity and Harmony": vast are those great fields; their wetlands and their plains.
translations.idiomatic: Second offering — "Longevity and Harmony": vast are the great fields, their wetlands and plains.

sentences.zh: 耒耜雲載，驂馭之間。

translations.literal: Plough and harrow like clouds in bearing; between the paired teams.
translations.idiomatic: Plough and harrow move like clouds; teams draw between the furrows.

sentences.zh: 報本思享，亞獻惟虔。

translations.literal: Repaying the root, thinking to enjoy; second offering only in reverence.
translations.idiomatic: Repaying the root, we think to offer; the second offering is reverence alone.

sentences.zh: 神其歆之，自古有年。

translations.literal: May the spirit enjoy this; from antiquity there have been fruitful years.
translations.idiomatic: May the spirit enjoy this; fruitful years have come since antiquity.

sentences.zh: 配位云：后稷配天，興於有邰。

translations.literal: Paired seat says: Hou Ji paired with Heaven, arose at You Tai.
translations.idiomatic: The paired seat recites: Hou Ji, paired with Heaven, arose at You Tai.

sentences.zh: 誕降嘉種，有栽有培。

translations.literal: He sent down fine seed; there was planting, there was nurturing.
translations.idiomatic: He sent down fine seed; it was planted and nurtured.

sentences.zh: 俶載南畝，祗事三推。

translations.literal: Beginning to bear the southern fields; reverently serving the three ploughings.
translations.idiomatic: Work begins in the southern fields; we reverently perform the three ploughings.

sentences.zh: 佑神再獻，歆我尊罍。

translations.literal: Assisting the spirit in second offering; enjoying our honored urns.
translations.idiomatic: He assists the spirit in the second offering; may it enjoy our honored urns.

sentences.zh: 終獻，《壽和之曲》：帝耤之典，享祀是資，潔豐嘉慄，鹹仰於斯。

translations.literal: Final offering, "Longevity and Harmony": the imperial ploughing canon — feasting and sacrifice thereby sustained; pure, abundant, fine grain — all look up to this.
translations.idiomatic: Final offering — "Longevity and Harmony": the imperial ploughing canon sustains feast and sacrifice; pure, abundant, fine grain — all look up to this.

sentences.zh: 時維親耕，享我農師。

translations.literal: The season is personal ploughing; we feast our agricultural master.
translations.idiomatic: The season is the Emperor's own ploughing; we feast our agricultural master.

sentences.zh: 禮成於三，以訖陳詞。

translations.literal: The rite completes at three; thereby ending the presented words.
translations.idiomatic: The rite completes at three offerings; the presented words are ended.

sentences.zh: 配位云：嘉德之薦，民和歲豐。

translations.literal: Paired seat says: fine virtue's offering — people harmonious, years abundant.
translations.idiomatic: The paired seat recites: fine virtue's offering — people in harmony, years abundant.

sentences.zh: 帝命率育，報本之功。

translations.literal: The Emperor's command broadly nurtures; repaying the root's merit.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor's command nurtures all broadly; we repay the root's merit.

sentences.zh: 陳常時夏，其德其功。

translations.literal: Setting forth the constant seasons of summer; its virtue, its merit.
translations.idiomatic: We set forth the constant seasons of summer, its virtue and merit.

sentences.zh: 齊明有格，惟獻之終。

translations.literal: Purification bright has presence; only the offering's end.
translations.idiomatic: Purification is bright and presence draws near; this is the offering's end.

sentences.zh: 徹饌，《永和之曲》：於赫先農，歆此潔修。

translations.literal: Removing the feast, "Eternal Harmony": how blazing is the Progenitor of Agriculture; enjoying this pure observance.
translations.idiomatic: Removing the feast — "Eternal Harmony": how blazing is the Progenitor of Agriculture, enjoying this pure observance.

sentences.zh: 於篚於爵，於饌於羞。

translations.literal: In baskets and in goblets; in feasts and in delicacies.
translations.idiomatic: In baskets and goblets, in feast and delicacies.

sentences.zh: 禮成告徹，神惠敢留。

translations.literal: The rite complete, announcing withdrawal; the spirit's grace — who dares detain?
translations.idiomatic: The rite is complete and withdrawal announced; who would dare detain the spirit's grace?

sentences.zh: 餕及終畝，豐年是求。

translations.literal: Leftovers reach the final furrow; an abundant year is sought.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrificial leftovers reach the final furrow; we seek a year of plenty.

sentences.zh: 送神，《永和之曲》：神無不在，於昭於天。

translations.literal: Sending off the Spirit, "Eternal Harmony": the spirit is nowhere absent; manifest in Heaven, manifest in the sky.
translations.idiomatic: Sending off the Spirit — "Eternal Harmony": the spirit is nowhere absent, bright in Heaven above.

sentences.zh: 曰迎曰送，於享之筵。

translations.literal: Called welcoming, called sending off — at the banquet of enjoyment.
translations.idiomatic: We welcome and we send off at the banquet of enjoyment.

sentences.zh: 冕衣在列，金石在懸。

translations.literal: Crown robes ranked in row; metal and stone [instruments] hung suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Crown robes stand in ranks; metal and stone instruments hang suspended.

sentences.zh: 往無不之，其佩翩翩。

translations.literal: Going — nowhere not reached; their girdle pendants flutter lightly.
translations.idiomatic: Going forth, nowhere is beyond reach; girdle pendants flutter lightly.

sentences.zh: 望瘞，《太和之曲》：祝帛牲醴，先農既歆。

translations.literal: Gazing at the burial, "Supreme Harmony": prayer silks, victims, and sweet wine — the Progenitor of Agriculture has already enjoyed.
translations.idiomatic: Gazing at the burial — "Supreme Harmony": prayer silks, victims, and sweet wine — the Progenitor of Agriculture has accepted.

sentences.zh: 不留不褻，瘞之厚深。

translations.literal: Not detained, not profaned; burial thick and deep.
translations.idiomatic: Nothing detained, nothing profaned; burial thick and deep.

sentences.zh: 有幽其瘞，有赫其臨。

translations.literal: There is darkness in the burial; there is blazing in the approach.
translations.idiomatic: Darkness lies in the burial; blazing light in the approach.

sentences.zh: 曰禮之常，匪今斯今。

translations.literal: Called the rite's constant — not only today, this today.
translations.idiomatic: This is the rite's constant — not for today alone, but for all time.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖九年定享先蠶樂章。

translations.literal: Ninth year of Jiajing — fixed the music for the Feast to the Progenitor of Sericulture.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing reign year 9: hymns for the Feast to the Progenitor of Sericulture were established.

sentences.zh: 迎神，《貞和之曲》：於穆惟神，肇啓蠶桑。

translations.literal: Welcoming the Spirit, "Chaste Harmony": how solemn is the spirit; first opening mulberry and silkworm.
translations.idiomatic: Welcoming the Spirit — "Chaste Harmony": how solemn is the spirit, who first opened mulberry and silkworm cultivation.

sentences.zh: 衣我萬民，保我家邦。

translations.literal: Clothing our ten thousand people; protecting our family and state.
translations.idiomatic: You clothe our myriad people and protect our house and realm.

sentences.zh: 茲舉曠儀，春日載陽。

translations.literal: This performance is a grand rite; spring days bear the sun.
translations.idiomatic: This grand rite is performed as spring days grow warm.

sentences.zh: 恭迎霞馭，靈氣洋洋。

translations.literal: Reverently welcoming the cloud carriage; spirit vapor lush and ample.
translations.idiomatic: We reverently welcome the cloud carriage; spirit vapor is lush and ample.

sentences.zh: 奠帛，《壽和之曲》：神其臨只，有苾有芬。

translations.literal: Offering silks, "Longevity and Harmony": may the spirit draw near; there is fragrance, there is aroma.
translations.idiomatic: Offering silks — "Longevity and Harmony": may the spirit draw near, fragrant and fine.

sentences.zh: 乃獻玉歊，乃奠文纁。

translations.literal: Thus offering fragrant jade; thus setting forth patterned scarlet.
translations.idiomatic: We offer fragrant jade and set forth patterned scarlet silks.

sentences.zh: 仰祈昭鑑，淑氣氤氳。

translations.literal: Looking up, praying for bright mirroring; gentle vapor dense and swirling.
translations.idiomatic: We look up and pray for bright regard; gentle vapor swirls dense.

sentences.zh: 顧茲蠶婦，祁祁如云。

translations.literal: Looking upon these sericulture women — numerous as clouds.
translations.idiomatic: We look upon these sericulture women, numerous as clouds.

sentences.zh: 初獻，曲同奠帛。

translations.literal: First offering — tune same as offering silks.
translations.idiomatic: First offering — the tune is the same as for offering silks.

sentences.zh: 亞獻，《順和之曲》：載舉清觴，蠶祀孔明。

translations.literal: Second offering, "Yielding Harmony": bearing raised clear goblets; sericulture sacrifice very bright.
translations.idiomatic: Second offering — "Yielding Harmony": we raise clear goblets; the sericulture sacrifice shines clear.

sentences.zh: 以格以享，鼓瑟吹笙。

translations.literal: To draw near and to enjoy; strumming se, blowing sheng.
translations.idiomatic: You draw near and accept; se is strummed and sheng is blown.

sentences.zh: 陰教用彰，坤儀允貞。

translations.literal: Yin teaching is thereby manifest; Kun's bearing is truly constant.
translations.idiomatic: Yin teaching is thereby manifest; the bearing of Earth is truly constant.

sentences.zh: 神之聽之，鑑此禋誠。

translations.literal: Spirit, hear this; mirror this sacrificial sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: Spirit, hear us; look upon this sacrificial sincerity.

sentences.zh: 終獻，《寧和之曲》：神之格思，桑土是宜。

translations.literal: Final offering, "Tranquil Harmony": the spirit draws near; mulberry soil is fitting.
translations.idiomatic: Final offering — "Tranquil Harmony": the spirit draws near; mulberry soil is fitting.

sentences.zh: 三繅七就，惟此繭絲。

translations.literal: Three soakings, seven strippings — only this cocoon silk.
translations.idiomatic: Three soakings and seven strippings yield this cocoon silk alone.

sentences.zh: 獻禮有終，神不我遺。

translations.literal: Offering rite has its end; the spirit does not leave us behind.
translations.idiomatic: The offering rite has its end; the spirit does not forsake us.

sentences.zh: 錫我純服，藻繪皇儀。

translations.literal: Bestowing on us pure garments; embroidered patterns, imperial bearing.
translations.idiomatic: You bestow pure garments upon us, embroidered with imperial pattern.

sentences.zh: 徹饌，《安和之曲》：俎豆具徹，式禮莫愆。

translations.literal: Removing the feast, "Secure Harmony": trays and vessels are fully withdrawn; the rite's form without transgression.
translations.idiomatic: Removing the feast — "Secure Harmony": trays and vessels are fully withdrawn; the rite's form is without fault.

sentences.zh: 既匡既敕，我祀孔虔。

translations.literal: Already corrected, already instructed; our sacrifice is very reverent.
translations.idiomatic: All is corrected and instructed; our sacrifice is deeply reverent.

sentences.zh: 我思古人，葛覃惟賢。

translations.literal: We think of the ancients — Ge Tan alone is worthy.
translations.idiomatic: We think of the ancients; Ge Tan alone is worthy.

sentences.zh: 明靈歆只，永顧桑阡。

translations.literal: The bright spirit enjoys; forever looking upon mulberry fields and paths.
translations.idiomatic: The bright spirit accepts; forever it watches the mulberry fields.

sentences.zh: 送神，《恆和之曲》：神之升矣，日霽霞蒸。

translations.literal: Sending off the Spirit, "Constant Harmony": the spirit ascends; the day clears, clouds steam.
translations.idiomatic: Sending off the Spirit — "Constant Harmony": the spirit ascends; the day clears and clouds rise like steam.

sentences.zh: 相此女紅，杼軸其興。

translations.literal: Looking upon these women's red [silk]; shuttles and looms thereby rise.
translations.idiomatic: We look upon the women's crimson silk; shuttles and looms spring to life.

sentences.zh: 茲返玄宮，鸞鳳翔騰。

translations.literal: Now returning to the dark palace; luan and phoenix soar aloft.
translations.idiomatic: Now You return to the dark palace; luan and phoenix soar aloft.

sentences.zh: 瞻望弗及，永錫嘉徵。

translations.literal: Gazing and looking — unable to reach; forever bestowing auspicious signs.
translations.idiomatic: We gaze but cannot reach You; forever bestow auspicious signs.

sentences.zh: 望燎，曲同送神。

translations.literal: Gazing at the burning — tune same as sending off the Spirit.
translations.idiomatic: Gazing at the burning — the tune is the same as for sending off the Spirit.
